Inheriting her mother’s passion for interiors and property development she went on to study interior architecture and design at university. After gaining 7 years experience working with award winning design studios in London and wanting to realise her life long dream of establishing a creative and successful interior design studio she made the leap of faith and formed her own company. Wanting to create a business with a family central ethos and to honour her strong family foundations she decided to call the company after her mother’s maiden name, Muchmore. Muchmore Design is now a family owned interior architecture and design studio based in Brixton, South London. Specialists in the private and commercial property sector, we offer interior design services to private clients, developers and architects throughout the UK. Our full turnkey solution allows us to consult, manage and deliver at every stage of a project, from concept through to completion we guide clients every step of the way! This is made possible due to our carefully selected team who together provide a unique set of multi-disciplined skills under one roof. Over 30 years combined industry experience and expertise across design, furnishing, project management, procurement and installation means Linsey and the team are well placed to undertake the following projects. Private Home Renovations New Build Homes & Apartments

name: Mitchell Rose (Design) Ltd.
description: Hello and welcome to some highlights from our Portfolio ! We are a small team with experience of working predominantly on Residential projects and have also worked on commercial projects - from workspaces to shopping centres. We offer an inspiring and supportive one to one service, collaborating closely with our clients, to create a wonderful home environment. From a concept to completion 'Bespoke Build' or a complete 'Renovation' of an exsiting house, or principle rooms, we are here to design the best spaces for you and with you. We only undertake a handful of projects every year to allow us to provided a truly dedicated service. We have built our business on personal recommendations and have established a reputation for elegant, unique and calm spaces that express the vision, personality and practical needs of our clients. We pride ourselves on our calm, creative and collaborative one to one approach. Our ethos is to create nurturing and beautiful spaces that are a joy to be in and use - Form and Function of equal measure. Lisa Mitchell - Design Director

name: STUDIO SONA
description: STUDIO SONA is a boutique interior architecture studio, focusing on the luxury residential and commercial market, across London and abroad. The company's projects have ranged from renovating period properties, rebuilding modern townhouses and developing commercial spaces in and around central London, to villas in the South of France. Led by Lisa Sharistani, an accredited member of the British Institute of Interior Design, the team brings years of experience and expertise, unparalleled knowledge, and creativity to every project. With an extensive network of trusted suppliers, we offer a comprehensive design service that supports clients throughout their entire journey. The company's expertise spans various styles and project types, allowing us to create tailored solutions that meet each client's unique needs. From initial concept to final execution, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and enhancing the functionality, beauty and uniqueness of every space we design. The central tenet of Studio SONA’s design philosophy is the focus on curating personalised, deeply meaningful experiences that align perfectly with each clients personality and aspiration.

name: Keates Interiors Ltd
description: Lisa has over two decades of experience working on high end projects, from European royal residences to contemporary eco new builds. With an extensive grounding in classical architecture and interiors, Lisa's expertise as director gives her the perfect basis to create interiors of timeless elegance. Her fine balance of intuitive design and meticulous planning ensures her clients' expectations are always exceeded.

name: Liza Evans Interior Design
description: Acknowledged as a top 20 Interior Designer by The Telegraph, I work with clients in San Francisco, London, and Internationally. Our surroundings have a lasting effect on our senses and our sense of wellbeing. My design approach focuses on a stimulating experience through an exploration of Feng Shui, colors, forms, materials, and reconnecting people with nature. I emphasize the serenity and beauty to create homes which are sophisticated, luxurious and understated. If you demand the finest workmanship, finishes, materials and a bespoke interior design experience, we work closely with architects and contractors from concept through to completion to ensure our projects run professionally, smoothly on time and on budget. Whether you are looking to remodel a whole house or decorate a room get in touch and let’s start your journey to a mindful, restorative home together. Head over to my website for more information - www.lizaevans.com AWARDS Our work has been shortlisted in 2016, 2015 & 2012 for International Design & Architecture Awards for a show apartment project in San Francisco for developer client Crescent Heights, a Home Cinema project for a residential client in Hampstead, and The Oxford & Cambridge Club in Pall Mall, London. GIVING We are committed to undertaking one pro bono commercial or residential interior design project a year to benefit a charity or non profit organization. Please send us details in order for us to consider your project.

name: Stellar & Co
description: We are a dedicated design studio based in Hampton, Surrey. We offer a full design service for residential and small commercial clients both in the UK and across Europe. We welcome work on period properties as well as new builds. We get involved in all aspects of the project from concept and spatial planning, through to the finer architectural finishes, and selection of fabrics, furnishings and decoration. Our work responds to the needs of the client whilst creating a beautiful aesthetic. We have built up an impressive book of trades and crafts people, as well as suppliers, ensuring the highest level of quality and design.

name: Park Grove Design Ltd.
description: Lori Pinkerton-Rolet and her team at Park Grove Design base their work on a simple philosophy: good design should be timeless and unique. Our clients are partners with us in the design process and are assured of continued support during and after project completion. An interior design professional since 1992, Lori's work has taken her from North America to Europe, and most recently Africa. Park Grove Design achieves high levels of client satisfaction through the innovative and creative use of new materials, attention to detail, and outstanding project coordination. The portfolio of work is primarily boutique hotel projects and work with property developers, but ranges from15th Century manor houses and state-of-the-art new builds to offices and residential care homes. The company's work has been featured in Hospitality Interiors; idFX; The Evening Standard; House & Garden; Homes & Gardens; Ideal Home; Rooms & Living, and many other magazine titles and books. Lori is a Past President of the British Institute of Interior Design. She is also an ADR Group Accredited Mediator. To view Lori's hotel portfollio please visit the Park Grove website .

name: LGW Designs Ltd
description: Louisa Greville Williams has been working as an interior designer for more than 30 years and is perhaps best known as the GW in Vanrenen GW Designs, a House and Garden Top 100 firm. Louisa relaunched LGW Designs to continue her work in helping domestic and international clients express their lifestyle and personality in their homes. The broad network of suppliers and contractors Louisa has worked with over many years, allows her to create wonderful interiors and deliver projects of all types and sizes. These can range from the simplest decorative task to the most complex building project. Using strong and unexpected colours, Louisa loves mixing old and new to create warmth, comfort and surprise. A fascination with shapes and spaces, and a love of architectural and design detail drive everything Louisa does. Traditional, but with an overlay of eclecticism and constantly excited about all areas of her work, Louisa is determined to bring happiness and contentment to her clients. Nothing is left to chance, with the LGW team working hard to eliminate stress from their clients’ lives. Years of managing projects of all types allows Louisa to know exactly which levers to pull and when; design is obviously key, but delivery is paramount. Personal, individual, and intimate; Louisa offers her clients detailed design advice and a commitment to deliver smooth and efficient service that creates real value.

name: Gomm Studio Ltd
description: Gomm Studio is a luxury, family-run interior design studio based in Wimbledon Village, London. We design bespoke interiors for residential and commercial properties in the UK and abroad.

name: LB furniture Ltd (Trading as Studio LBI)
description: Studio LBI provides Interior Design services for large scale properties. Louise and her team work with architects to bring their vision to life and with skilled contractors make it a reality. Light filled rooms, colourful textiles, natural elements, earthy textures, and brushed metals are the pallet that define and can always distinguish a Studio LBI home. We believe in getting to really know our clients in order to give them the best quality service. We aim to create elegant spaces with a classical influence and a contemporary edge. We always strive to offer something different and unique. Designs that are not dictated by current trends on the high street. However large or small your project, Studio LBI is passionate about providing you with the best service to bring your home to life.

name: Louis Zhang Studio Limited
description: Led by its Creative Director, Louis Zhang, with offices in London and Chengdu, Louis Zhang Studio is an interior design collective that comprises a diverse group of passionate, dynamic and talented individuals. The Studio draws on their combined expertise and vast knowledge to create designs steeped in art, fashion, history, photography and culture. Louis Zhang graduated from the globally renowned Central Saint Martins with a BA Hons in Textiles and the prestigious Inchbald School of Design with a MA in Architectural Interior Design. With a superior knowledge of textiles as well as the creative and technical aspects of architectural interior design, Louis has an unparalleled understanding and the utmost respect of how colour, material and texture can transform and breathe life into a space. These are key to the Studio’s design philosophy, and can enhance a space to the client’s every requirement. Attention to detail for the clients’ preferences creates beautiful, special, unique spaces, that are loved and offer maximum utility and functionality, whether that be for commercial, hospitality, residential, private developers or high net-worth clients.

name: Lost and Found Interiors
description: "Lost and Found" sums us up: it’s what we do. We discover spaces that are lost, details that are missing and delight in mixing the old with the new. We’re at our happiest when we‘re breathing fresh life into a forgotten, under-utilised room, reviving a tired-old treasure, and creating interiors that are ‘just so’. Great design is about a million little things coming together to turn a home into something very special and wonderful. Our Studio believes in designing beautiful environments, which add long term value to your property. Our approach is intrinsically sustainable; looking to retain, refresh and restore what’s there, whilst ensuring that our designs compliment and reflect a Client's personality and lifestyle.

name: LPE Designs Ltd
description: At LPE Designs we believe great design is about collaboration with you. We don’t follow a “one-size-fits-all” approach and we aren’t about trends — instead, we focus on truly understanding you, your needs, and how you want your space to feel. Every space we design is a reflection of who you are, what you need, and how you live. We know that your home isn’t just a place to look at — it’s where life happens. Whether you have children, pets, or a love for entertaining, practicality is at the core of everything we do. From thoughtful storage solutions for school bags and muddy shoes to creating cozy nooks for family downtime, we design spaces that work for you — not just around you. Our process is rooted in listening. We take the time to understand your lifestyle, your daily routines, and what makes you feel at home. Then, we create environments that reflect your personality and offer the functionality you need, without compromising on style. At LPE Designs , we don’t just design interiors. We design homes that fit your life. If you’d like to learn more about our design process or discuss your next project, please do get in touch. We’d love to hear from you! Background Lily, the founder of LPE Designs, brings a wealth of experience to every project. With a background in the Luxury Industry and five years spent in the Private Collections & Furniture Department at Christie’s, Lily has a unique eye for quality and design. After training at KLC School of Interior Design, she went on

name: Lucinda Martin Interior Design
description: Lucinda Martin Interior Design is a design studio specialising in residential interiors for private clients. Based in Shropshire, their diverse portfolio encompasses country houses, London homes and many other projects across the country. Lucinda manages all commissions personally, offering a one-on-one service to ensure her clients are guided through the process seamlessly. Their style is classic, elegant, fun but also diverse. They pride themselves on the ability to tailor designs to their client’s taste whether they favour a paired back neutral scheme, or a more colourful textured palette.

name: Lucy Winterwood Interior Design
description: Lucy gained a First-Class Honours Degree in Interior Architecture and Design. Shortly after graduating, she discovered that her true passion lay in Interior Design, with a particular interest in sensitively restoring heritage and period properties. With more than a decade of experience in the High-End Interior Design market, including demanding and ambitious projects across the UK, Europe, and Asia, Lucy went on to establish her own studio: Lucy Winterwood Interior Design. Lucy specialises in subtle, timeless luxury, creating homes that feel warm, inviting and beautifully considered. Each project is tailored to the personality and lifestyle of the client, crafting designs that reflect their character and memories rather than imposing a fixed ‘house style’. Resulting in spaces that are deeply personal. Projects range from single-room redecoration to full turnkey home renovations. Covering every stage of the process: from space planning and concept development to sourcing materials and furnishings, over-seeing contractors, installation, and adding the finishing touches. The studio is based in St Albans, Hertfordshire, serving clients across Hertfordshire, North London, and the surrounding areas.

name: Lungfish Architects
description: Lungfish Architects is a design-led, award winning architecture and interior design practice. Our design philosophy focuses on the synergy between not only architecture and interiors, but also spaces and wellbeing. Starting with a concept, we shape and develop an idea with you – right from a diagram, to defining the details. To deliver creative and inspiring interiors, we work to understand both the client’s and the end user’s needs.

name: Lynne Hunt London Ltd.
description: Lynne Hunt London creates a kind of luxury that is contemporary, fresh and full of unexpected twists. Our design is audacious, not ostentatious, drawing inspiration from local environments and cultures to create interiors that range from the chic and urban to the organic and whimsical. At our Chelsea studio, a small team of designers works with Lynne on projects for hotels, residential, resorts, neew developments, restaurants and bars, both in the UK and much further afield. Our experience encompasses new-build and refurbishment interiors for some of the world’s leading destinations and hoteliers, discerning residential clients, from London to the South Pacific via the Mediterranean and the Middle East. Lynne Hunt trained in interior design at Brooks College, Long Beach, California. After graduating, she returned to the UK and worked on her first hotel projects at Ezra Attia & Associates in London, including the Library Bar at the Lanesborough and the Windsor Lounge of the Athenaeum Hotel. At Gregory Aeberhard, Lynne designed and project managed refurbishments for leading hotels in the UAE, Jordan, Bahrain, Oslo and on the Côte d’Azur. In 1993, she formed Hunt Hamilton Zuch, focusing on luxury interiors. The company’s first assignment was to redesign a set of cloakrooms. Fortunately, the Hyatt Carlton Tower in London invited HHZ back several times to refit more glamorous areas of the hotel.In 1995 Lynne was chosen to create a set of deluxe guest rooms at Claridge’s – the firs

name: Studio Sorana Ltd
description: Studio Sorana Ltd (formally Amongst Things) launched in 2018 and we are going from strength to strength. Day-to-day we work hard to design and deliver spaces that encompass our clients practical and aesthetic needs. Our collaborative approach encourages communication and an exchange of ideas. We bring a strong eye for design, along with strategic budget management, connections with trades and suppliers all harnessed by years of experience. Lead Designer & Director Maddy began her career in design in 2007, however, long before this her creative nature was apparent; painting and drawing from as early as she can remember. As a kid, to the frustration of her parents, she (and her two sisters) would devise home renovations and help decorate their family home. This led Maddy to study art & design at university and eventually building design, achieving a BA Hons in Architecture in 2010 from the University of Kent. Over the last 12 years Maddy has worked across many interior design sectors and with brands and clients such as Burberry, Calvin Klein, Affinity Sutton (now Clarion Housing), YOTEL, Nationwide, Marriott, Sheraton and Taylor Wimpey Central London. She now brings years of industry experience and her expertise’s to Amongst Things (project completed at HLM Architects). We asked Maddy…What are your key Passions ? Sourcing new, innovative and sustainable materials. Using traditional materials in a contemporary way. Keeping up to date with the latest software, working to improve

name: Maha Khaliq Design Limited
description: MKDL is a multi-disciplinary London based studio, where the design team’s creative experience and intuition are paired with a precise eye for detail. We believe interiors should be both beautiful and practical for everyday living, combining functionality with timeless aesthetics. Through established relationships with key suppliers and contractors, MKDL delivers exceptional interior solutions across Residential, Commercial, Hospitality and Property Development sectors. Every project is unique, shaped by bespoke materials and continuous collaboration to reflect each client’s individual taste, lifestyle and aspirations, creating distinctive spaces that offer a truly incomparable experience.

name: Architecture For London
description: Ben is an architect and interior designer specialising in sustainable residential projects in London. He founded his RIBA Chartered Practice, Architecture for London , in 2011 and has since designed a number of widely published and award-winning projects. He leads on design, sustainability , practice management and strategic direction. Architecture for London's residential projects include new build architectural homes, refurbishments of heritage properties and house extensions at all scales. With AFL Build , the company can offer a complete turn-key solution, including design & build, sustainability, interior design, joinery and garden design. AFL creates healthy buildings with natural, breathable materials that achieve the highest sustainability and comfort standards, including Passivhaus and EnerPhit . This approach creates warm, low-energy homes and workplaces that are a joy to inhabit. Ben was selected for the annual Rising Star Award by the RIBA Journal in 2017, and has since been a member of the jury for the RIBA / Grand Designs House of the Year Award 2022, and the peer review panel for the 2024 'Don't Move, Improve!' awards. He is a Passivhaus designer with significant technical expertise in the design of low energy buildings. Ben studied architecture at UCL in London, where he graduated with 1st class honours and distinctions. He received several prizes for his work, including the Sir Andrew Taylor Environmental Design Prize, the Ambrose Poynter prize for distinguis

name: Kings Interiors Ltd
description: Established in 2020, Kings Interiors Ltd was founded by Lead Interior Designer Gosia King. With over a decade of experience in high-end residential design, Gosia brings a meticulous eye for detail and a passion for creating homes that feel both luxurious and deeply personal. Her signature aesthetic — a refined balance of classic and contemporary — translates each client’s vision into elegant, timeless interiors that celebrate comfort, craftsmanship and proportion. Every project is approached with a tailored sensibility, ensuring the design not only enhances the architecture but reflects the individuality of the client. Gosia has earned a reputation for delivering sophisticated, beautifully curated interiors for private clients and property developers across the UK and internationally. Her work embodies calm, understated luxury and an unwavering commitment to quality in every detail.

name: Manjiri Kulkarni Interior Architecture
description: Manjiri is a freelance consultant designer with 25+ years experience in the commercial, retail, education and residential sector in the UK and overseas with emphasis on interior architecture/design and project management & delivery. Project sectors include workplace design, work for major retailers, supermarkets and banking. Manjiri has recently set up her own practice after working within well renowned practices in senior roles. She has a versatile and flexible approach, good managerial and effective communication skills. Manjiri runs contracts on varying scales and budgets and also provides consultancy to national architectural practices. Manjiri has vast experience in managing projects on roll-outs with restricted timelines and budgets as well as vast experience of running projects from inception through to completion, sketch design, client/contractor liaison and on-site delivery. She has a passion to provide a personalised service to residential and commercial clients which has led her to set up her own practice. QUALIFICATIONS: FULL MEMBER BIID (BRITISH INSTITUTE OF INTERIOR DESIGNERS) SINCE 2008 MCIAT ARCHITECTURAL TECHNOLOGIST 2000 - 2002 MASTERS DEGREE IN INTERIOR ARCHITECTURE, BURG GIEBICHENSTEIN GERMANY 1997 - 2000 BSC INTERIOR ARCHITECTURE, SCOTT SUTHERLAND SCHOOL OF ARCHITECTURE, RGU, UK DIPLOMA INTERIOR DESIGN AND BACHELOR OF COMMERCE & ECONOMICS- UNIV OF MUMBAI, INDIA

name: Marcia Tucker Interiors LLC
description: Marcia Tucker is best known for her youthful approach to traditional and transitional high-end interior design. Marcia likes clean, classic backgrounds, be it either traditional or modern architecture with the use of fresh colors, comfortable seating, good lighting, great artwork and elements that add a touch of whimsy that ultimately reflects the owner' s personality. Marcia adeptly mixes fine antiques, custom upholstery and modern elements to create environments that are above all exciting, appropriate and comfortable. She continues to seek inspiration for her design work during frequent trips to Europe and her voracious appetite for architecture and the decorative arts.

name: Mar Design
description: About Raquel, With over 15 years of design experience, creative thinker, and founder of Mar Design, Raquel, understands the benefits of engaging, high-quality design that creates comfortable and inspirational homes and workspaces. Raquel is a qualified architect that has spent her career sharing a natural talent for interior design. Known for creating spaces that are not only eye-catching but functional, Raquel spent many years designing hospitality projects such as 5-star hotels, restaurants, spas, gentlemen’s clubs, lobby areas, and high-end residential projects. Through the variety of projects Raquel played a part in, she was able to garner a wealth of experience and expertise in making spaces work and feel better. Helped by a commercially-driven mindset, Raquel is uniquely placed to help clients maximize ROI, elevate a property’s performance and increase investor’s wealth using design as a platform. After years of working on a range of projects, Raquel founded Mardesign, a specialist studio that focuses on interior design for property investors. The firm has now helped hundreds of clients create impressive spaces, with the signature focused yet clever, functional yet fun Mardesign touch. The Mar Design difference: Mar Design is on a mission to create stylish spaces that tenants and buyers will love to call ‘their space.’ This means ensuring a high return on investment, reduced voids, high occupancy rates, more long-term tenancies, and increased property value for our clie

name: Studio Schubert
description: Studio Schubert is an interior design and architecture practice specialising in high-end residential projects in all areas of London, including Central London, Wimbledon, Streatham, Dulwich, Crystal Palace, Richmond, Camden Town, Hampstead Heath and many more. Tailored approach to each project and good understanding of budgets enables us to create stunning results each time. Whether you are a private client or an investor we will provide you with excellent service making sure that your ideas are heard and ambitions are fulfilled. "At Studio Schubert we understand that London properties are a source of financial stability and an income. For most of us home is also simply the most important place on earth. This is why we take pride in turning our clients dreams and plans into reality - that's what makes us tick."

name: Spacetime
description: Margaret Greetham is a qualified interior architect with over twenty years of experience in commercial and retail design and over decade dedicated to the field of residential interior design. Creating comfortable and unique living environments through attention to detail, use of texture and colour, maximizing sense of space and light, recent work ranges from apartments and house extensions to extensive refurbishment of high-end residences, including gardens and out buildings. Spacetime was founded in 2010. Often layering contemporary features over the tradtional fabric of the building, Spacetime works closely and in partnership with clients to realise their vision and create beautiful and livable interiors. Margaret's belief that each space in need of a transformation has an inherent character, which deserves to be considered ahead of its function working closely and in partnership with clients to realise each. Unique, refined, welcoming and intelligent interiors emerge in the process of successfully blending the character and function of the spaces with the creativity and passion of the people curating them.

name: M de M Architects Ltd
description: Marie-Isabel de Monseignat-Lavrov is an internationally recognised and published RIBA/ARB Architect and BIID interior designer. Born in Monaco, and residing in London, her style is the perfect blend of curated modern elegance and highly functional, timeless design, creating optimised and harmonious spaces in which life can effortlessly take place. A graduate of AA School of Architecture and Westminster University, Marie-Isabel honed her craft while working for iconic practices, MVSA, Acme Ltd and Alberto Pinto, where she served as design and architect lead for a variety of urban master-planning, architecture and interior design projects. Marie-Isabel compliments her practice by tutoring at different Universities for the last 10 years at the UAL Chelsea College of Art and Design and the Architectural Associations and is a regular critic to other universities such as Central Saint Martin and more. Established in 2018, M de M Architects Ltd practises across multiple disciplines; from Architecture to Interior Design for private homes and commercial projects to sourcing unique furniture for clients in the U.K, Belgium, France and Hong Kong. Each project is unique, taking primary cues from a convergence of architectural context, the client and the desire to create a level of sophistication that is never pretentious. Marie-Isabel’s philosophy is that exceptional design can only be achieved once it inspires a sense of balance and tells a story by bringing together architecture with c

name: Marina Hughes Interiors Ltd
description: Marina Hughes is the Founder and Creative Director of Marina Hughes Interiors, specialising in high-end residential interiors, major renovations and bespoke private homes. With over 18 years of experience across the residential and luxury hospitality sectors, Marina brings together creative vision and strong technical expertise. Her career has included the design of high-end residences, international hotels, restaurants and spas, giving her a detailed understanding of both the aesthetic and practical demands of complex interior projects. Marina's approach extends far beyond decoration. She is equally passionate about interior architecture, space planning and detailed design, developing considered layouts, technical drawings, bespoke joinery, lighting and material specifications alongside furniture, fabrics and decorative schemes. This allows each project to be conceived as a complete interior, where architecture, functionality and decoration work seamlessly together. Her work is characterised by individuality rather than a prescribed house style. Drawing inspiration from art, architecture, travel and the personality of each client, Marina creates sophisticated interiors that are distinctive, highly personal and designed to stand the test of time. Through Marina Hughes Interiors, she works closely with clients, architects, contractors, specialist makers and suppliers, guiding projects from the initial design concept and technical development through to FF&E specification, proc

name: CATO Creative Ltd
description: Hello, we’re CATO creative… an ARB Registered architecture, interior design and planning agency based in central London whose sole purpose is to create homes our clients love. Regardless of whether it’s townhouse, Listed Building, garden shed or a shoe box, we believe a home should be filled with light, space, colour and joy. We also believe that designing your home should be fun, engaging, and a little challenging too if you are prepared to push yourself further than what you know and what is ordinary. That’s where we come in. Working with our clients in a collaborative way, we create homes that are beautiful, practical and as individual as the people who live in them. These are homes for living, rather than homes that fit convention. We are all different so why should our homes all look the same? At CATO creative, home is a place where we flourish, where stories are made, where we just want to be. Whether it’s vibrant and bold or calm and elegant, our home needs to work for us. It needs to represent who we are as individuals and as a family. It needs to function practically. It has to be our own. If you believe this, CATO creative are here to help you.

name: Angel Martin Ltd
description: Martin Nealon Angel Martin Design | Interior Architecture & Design Heavyweight Interior Designer | Interior Architecture | Spatial Planning | Technical Design With over 40 years of experience, Martin Nealon is a heavyweight interior designer specialising in the design and transformation of substantial residential, heritage and commercial properties throughout the UK and internationally. Martin's expertise lies in understanding how buildings should function, identifying opportunities within existing and proposed architecture, and developing considered design solutions that respond to the individual requirements of each client. His approach combines creative vision with extensive technical knowledge, ensuring that design decisions are both aesthetically compelling and practically achievable. Working collaboratively with architects from the earliest stages of a project, Martin frequently reviews and rethinks proposed internal layouts, challenging conventional arrangements and developing creative alternatives that improve spatial relationships, circulation and functionality. His involvement can significantly influence the internal architecture of a building, helping to maximise its potential while respecting its original character. His approach begins with the client. Recognising that clients may not initially know precisely what they need, Martin takes time to understand how spaces will be used, establishing practical requirements before developing the design direction. Function

name: Mary Barber Fray Interior Design
description: Mary Barber Fray specialises in creating personal, liveable and comfortable spaces for her clients. They may look effortless, but are meticulously planned and individually designed. She is highlly experienced working with listed buildings and period properties. Mary is renowned for her innate sense of style and visual awareness, as well as a meticulous eye for detail and her client commitment. Her small team provides a full design service, including space planning, project co-ordination, sourcing and supplying lighting, bespoke items, floorcoverings and furnishings, antiques and artwork. South West based, with UK-wide clients, Mary is a long standing Member and past Director of the British Institute of Interior Design.

name: Mary Gannon Design
description: Mary Gannon is the driving force leading projects from concept to completion and working closely with clients to ensure the journey is seamless. Mary Gannon was an interior designer for Harrods before setting up her own company in 2005. Her wealth of experience lies within the bespoke residential sector, and spans everything from refurbishing period properties to designing the interiors of luxury apartments for leading developers. Mary and her team of seasoned professionals, offer a flexible service that adapts to the wishes of each client. She does not have a signature style. Instead, Mary strongly believes in responding to what people love, to create an interior that reflects their unique personality, passions and tastes.

name: Studio Ma
description: Studio Ma opened an interior design studio in 1998 in Osaka, Japan to help clients with beautiful and unique interiors. Her interior will realize the client's vision by understanding the client's style, preferences and needs and proposing various mood board styles. She also proposes originals of textile products for curtains and carpets to clients. Her sophisticated interior style is an interior style that is an eclectic of various eras and interior styles. She has many broad suppliers and the best craftsmen. Her uncompromising approach is always focused on achieving the client's ideals. Her interiors are elegant and comfortable, with a sophisticated, impressive and beautiful interior.

name: Freeman Studio
description: Freeman Studio is led by Mathew Freeman, President of the British Institute of Interior Design. Celebrating almost 20 years in the interior design industry in London, Mathew draws on this experience whilst working with clients across many disciplines including residential projects, both developer and private, and commercial projects. Passionate about materiality, detail, and sustainable solutions his work combines his love of artwork, rich textural concepts, and personal service. Personable, attentive and intuitive, Mathew works closely with clients to understand, question and deliver exceptional projects and beautiful homes.

name: Katie McCrum Studio
description: We are based in London and focus primarily on complete refubishments of homes and apartments across London. We also work on homes outside of London for our clients including a recently completed lakeside house in The Cotswolds and a ski chalet in Lech, Austria. Our studio is small by design because we believe that this enables us to have a deeper understanding of our clients, provide them an attentive service and ensure their satisfaction with the resulting scheme. We listen and form a solution that surpasses the initial brief. We seek to ensure that we have fun and fruitful relationships even though interior design can be a difficult process on occasion - we are problem solvers on behalf of our clients. The results speak for themselves with successful projects and being retained to work on multiple projects for our clients, also their confidence to recommend us for work with their friends and network. The service guides clients through all stages of design and follows the RIBA Plan of Work, helping clients assess the financial aspects of their project, deciding what they would like to achieve and all stages through to an exceptional quality resolution. We take on the stress so that our clients don’t have to. Working on private spaces that are also substantial investments means we communicate frequently and are transparent in our working to reduce understandable anxiety. We ensure that site works can proceed as smoothly and cost effectively as possible by taking time in the e

name: Amy Nicholas Interior Design
description: After studying Interior Design at York University, Megan has worked in both commercial and residential interiors and has found her home at Amy Nicholas Interiors, bringing a wealth of experience that belies her young age. Despite having her own distinctive style, Megan embraces all styles and aspects of interiors with a timeless yet contemporary approach. As an integral member of the Amy Nicholas team, Megan creates and enhances projects with her detailed technical drawings and elevations. With a particular interest in specifying bespoke items to ensure each project has an individual and personal touch, she designs with the client's vision at the forefront and aims to exceed all expectations.

name: Melissa Collaro Design
description: Director and Founder Melissa Collaro Leader, pro-active, ambitious, and multi-lingual CEO & Founder of Melissa Collaro Design.. She worked for over 15 years in the construction industry. Melissa has been raised by an Interior designer’s parents, but she decided to study architecture. Her knowledge in planning and building regulation together with interior design make her Wonder woman business! She loves challenges and that’s why she has a super energetic son! Does this make her Wonder woman for real?! During her free time, she loves yoga (hot in particular), and she is crazy about shopping! The Studio: Melissa Collaro Design Melissa Collaro Design is an Italian design team based on the collaboration and intertwining connection between professionals which offers a unique bespoke service built around you. We offer a wide range of services, from Planning Permission, Building Regulation drawings, to furniture and building. We can provide you with a bespoke Italian team at each stage of your project, from concept to completed construction. Our designs enhance the inherent character of the architecture and location, sympathetically blending the new with the original. Over the years we have recognised the profound importance of creating innovative and extraordinary spaces within the architectural envelope of a project. Space planning and how it responds to the diverse lifestyles of our clients is a critical discipline in creating homes made for living and increasing the value of eac

name: Mhairi Coyle Design Ltd
description: Mhairi Coyle is a distinguished London based interior designer, widely acknowledged for her sophisticated and timeless approach to design. Renowned for over two decades for creating elegant, richly layered interiors with a distinctive contemporary sensibility she has built a reputation for delivering homes that are visually compelling, deeply personal and exceptionally comfortable. Her work is defined by meticulous attention to detail, a refined use of colour and texture, and an instinctive understanding of how people inhabit their homes. Every project is approached with a highly considered and collaborative process, such as sourcing antique pieces and working with skilled craftsmen and artisans who share her commitment to quality and authenticity to create bespoke furniture, fabrics, wallpapers and lighting. Known for her engaging personality and confident use of colour and ability to balance bold design decisions, Mhairi moves effortlessly between period and contemporary styles. Whether restoring a Georgian family home or reimagining a modern apartment, she creates spaces that are both characterful and cohesive, with a strong emphasis on craftsmanship, comfort and longevity. Mhairi believes that exceptional interiors begin with a profound understanding of the client—their lifestyle, rituals and aspirations. “It’s very important to me to have a really good understanding of who my client is, how they live their lives and what they want from their home. Peace and tranquility,

name: Miaki
description: Established in 2021 by the talented Greek-American interior designer Mia Kitsinis, our design studio in south west London crafts spaces that are both elegant and uniquely layered. Each design embodies a blend of comfort, calm, and a touch of 'oomph', turning any space into a dream home designed to stand the test of time. Great design, in our belief, seamlessly intertwines balance and composition. The homes we envision and bring to fruition are not just structures; they are well-rounded stories, vividly expressed. Our designs form bridges, connecting the immediate environment with the broader world, making spaces feel alive, relevant, and deeply personal. While some of our projects echo the clean lines of modernism and others revel in classic intricacies, every space we touch is imbued with emphasis and soul. Our expertise spans the vast expanses of interior design and architecture, custom furniture creation, and art curation. Our practice of interior design has blossomed into rich partnerships with luminaries in architecture, art, luxury branding, real estate, landscape design, and artisanal crafts. This expansive network reflects our commitment to excellence, ensuring that our clients benefit from an integrated, world-class design experience. Confidentiality, trust, and unmatched skills are the cornerstones of our ethos. Every project we undertake is tailor-made, drawing inspiration from the site's unique attributes, our client's desires, and innovative design approaches. We

name: Vorbild Architecture Limited
description: VORBILD Architecture Ltd is an architectural and interior designer practice. We are registered with RIBA, ARB and BIID in the UK, as well as CROA in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region in France. VORBILD Architecture provides full architectural, interior design, landscaping, project management and property services. Our team aims at improving your life by reorganising and optimising the most important space you live in - your home. We have been featured in The Times, Ideal Home, House Beautiful, 25 Beautiful Homes, Kitchens Bedrooms & Bathrooms, A Place in The Sun, The Sunday Business Post, Kid's Interiors, Decoist, Nonagon Style. Practice longlisted for Don't Move Improve 2017 awards. We won Best of Houzz in 2017 until 2023. We speak French, German, Polish and, of course, English.

name: MCDA LTD
description: We have designed, renovated and redesigned high end hotels, residential projects throughout the world and were fortunate to work on very special projects. We create design concepts, implement design strategies and develop them throught the process together with the client. We have experience working with leading architects and designers on a variety of projects in many continents. Constantly striving to achieve the best results, very focused and bring an open minded and enquiring approach to all projects. Our studio has developed a strong team-working, concept development and technical skills in a busy internationally successful design practice.

name: St. George PLC - Berkeley Group
description: Graduating with a BA Hons diploma in Interior Architecture, Interior and Furniture Design from the University of Architecture and Urbanism in Bucharest, Romania, Mihaela gained most of her 19 years’ experience working in architectural practices in the UK, while maintaining a small interior design client base. Currently working in one of the largest residential architectural practices – HTA – she actively pursued the creation of an Interior Design department within the practice. The department proved to be extremely profitable from the first years of activity. Her style is highly functional and empathic to clients’ needs. She prides herself on getting to know her client and designing around his/her needs while maintaining her artistic integrity and a high-quality design. Her technical background and applied knowledge are well appreciated by both contractors and consultants, while her clients appreciate her professionalism and communication skills. An artist at heart, Mihaela paints in her spare time under the alias Mishu Bogan and hopes to get - at one point - an academic education in Fine Arts.

name: Koto
description: Millie Bryant is a Registered Interior Designer and Senior Designer at Koto Living, specialising in nature-inspired residential and hospitality interiors. Projects include the Cornwall Barn, Moor Hall Hotel, and Battersea Power Station.

name: Studio Kaimi
description: Studio Kaimi was founded by Japanese interior designer Minako Bryson in 2019. The quiet philosophies behind Studio Kaimi are represented in our name. In Japanese Kai 海 means sea, a symbol for nature and loving our planet, and Minako 美 means beauty, a symbol for calm, timeless elegance. Minako believes that the key to designing beautiful and sustainable spaces is listening to each client’s particular aspirations, goals and needs. She combines this understanding with careful consideration of the building and its environment and forms a story that is the meaningful foundation for designing interior spaces that are unique to each client. With over ten years of experience as an interior designer Minako’s love of colour, materials and texture inspired by nature, and a rigorous attention to detail and function bring each story to life. Studio Kaimi makes beautiful spaces that work, often finished with bespoke pieces of furniture and artwork that mix old with new and Eastern and Western cultures, made by their special network of fine artisans and artists in the UK, Europe and Japan. Minako’s dual cultural backgrounds, having been born in Japan and now living in the UK for more than fifteen years, means she is very comfortable working in both countries. Although Studio Kaimi is based in London, it is an international team of consultants, suppliers and makers who regularly span the two continents working on a mix of residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

name: Miriam Prada Design
description: I specialise in the transformation of spaces to suit the individual requirements of each project from conception to completion, no matter how unique or challenging its conditions. We treat each project as a journey; the finished product speaks for itself. Working in unison with the clients so that design development benefits from the input of both parties, arriving at final layout schemes complemented by selections of finishes and furniture for each space. The clients' lifestyles play a key role in the way in which we design; ensuring all decisions are made in keeping with the look and feel of the scheme. I maintain strong relationships with hundreds of manufacturers globally so that I am able to provide specifications for an unrivalled range of bespoke pieces. This also permits adaptability for the specific requirements of each scheme, no matter how intricate.

name: W1 Design Ltd
description: W1 Design Ltd is a London-based architecture and interior design practice specialising in commercial, hospitality, retail, workplace and residential projects. Established in 2012, the practice works with private clients, property owners, developers and businesses across London, the UK and Europe. Led by Moein Memari, an ARB-registered architect and member of the RIBA and BIID, W1 Design brings together architectural design, interior design and construction expertise within an integrated practice. The practice works across the full project lifecycle, from initial concept, feasibility and spatial planning through to planning, detailed design, technical coordination and, where required, construction and completion. Our approach combines creative design with a strong understanding of the practical and technical requirements of delivering a project. We consider each project in relation to its architectural context, intended use, budget and programme, with particular attention to proportion, materiality, detailing and the quality of the finished environment. W1 Design works across a diverse range of projects, from individual interior schemes and sensitive refurbishments to commercial fit-outs, hospitality and retail environments, residential refurbishments and new-build developments. The practice aims to create spaces that are distinctive, functional and carefully considered, with design quality maintained throughout the process of delivery. Services Architecture · Interior Design

name: West Nine Studio Ltd
description: Hi, I’m Monica, Owner of West Nine Studio. We’re an interior design studio specialising in high-end residential projects, with a strong focus on design-led interiors that are not only beautiful, but also highly considered in how they function day to day. Our work typically sits at the intersection of interior architecture and FF&E , so we’re just as involved in space planning, layouts and joinery as we are in furniture, materials and finishes. A lot of our projects are full refurbishments or new builds, where we’re working closely with architects, contractors and consultants from an early stage. What We Do At West Nine Studio, we offer a full interior design service , which generally includes: Space planning and layout development Interior architecture and joinery design Materials, finishes and bathroom design Lighting design and layouts FF&E specification — furniture, lighting, fabrics and styling Procurement and installation So we can either come in to support a specific part of a project, or manage the design process from concept all the way through to completion. Our Style In terms of style, we don’t have a fixed “house look”, but our work is often described as layered, calm and refined . We focus a lot on materiality, proportion and balance , rather than trends. The aim is always to create spaces that feel considered and cohesive — somewhere that feels both elevated and comfortable to live in. We tend to work with clients who want something that feels tailored and person

name: Miri Design Ltd
description: Where Precision Meets Purpose. At Miri Design, we don’t just design spaces—we create experiences. Your home should be more than beautiful; it should tell your story, bring you peace, and elevate the way you live. Inspired by Japanese precision and the art of mindful living, we craft interiors that balance aesthetics with intention, blending design with deeper purpose. Every detail is considered. Every piece holds meaning. Our approach is rooted in feng shui, colour psychology, and holistic design, creating spaces that feel as good as they look—reducing stress, enhancing well-being, and fostering a true sense of sanctuary. Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. We honour local craftsmanship, give vintage pieces new life, and consciously source materials with traceable origins from ethical makers. A beautiful home that isn’t just seen—it’s intentionally designed for a meaningful life.

name: Naomi Astley Clarke
description: Luxury London-based interior designer, Naomi Astley Clarke, is an established and highly experienced studio with expertise in the sympathetic renovation and refurbishment of residential and commercial properties. Named as one of Andrew Martin Top 100 in the World 2023 and a Top 50 Finest Interior Designer by Country & Town House, the studio mixes fine British craftsmanship with design flair from around the world, creating timelessly elegant, bespoke spaces that are second to none. Naomi has worked in the industry for over 25 years and is now one of London’s most sought-after designers. We vigorously protect our clients’ privacy and our small team ensures that we deliver a unique and personal service. Naomi and her team's distinctive talent, warmth and diligent approach have earned the studio almost 100% repeat custom. Our design and fit-out drawings are all carried out in-house to ensure the seamless delivery of our and our clients’ vision, however, we are always happy to work alongside architects for construction drawings and planning expertise if required. www.naomiastleyclarke.com

name: Natalia Miyar
description: Global travel, a rich cultural heritage, and an academic background are the driving forces that inspire Natalia Miyar's work. An intuitive creator with a love of beauty, Natalia approaches design with an understanding of balance and proportion. The results are spaces which are both serene and lively. Natalia's natural and learned ability to blend comfort with glamour has been honed in her transatlantic practice of architecture and interior design. As an architect, she developed a passion for materiality - a devotion she has carried through into her interior architecture and design work for a discerning national and international clientele. From London to Miami, Natalia Miyar Atelier is a conduit for creativity. The team comprises architects, interior and furniture designers, and sourcing experts. They use their international experience in luxury residential design to create immersive, sensory experiences - homes as wonderful as they are liveable.

name: Jacobs
description: Natalie GEADIZADEH - sENIOR INTERIOR Designer Natalie is a seasoned interior designer with over 15 years of experience shaping workplace environments that are both high-performing and aesthetically compelling. With a degree in Interior Architecture and Interior Design, she brings a multidisciplinary background spanning workplace, pharmaceutical, restoration, hospitality, and transport sectors. For the past 14 years, Natalie has been a key contributor at Jacobs, a global leader in professional services. Her portfolio includes both largescale and unique projects, where she has led and collaborated on interior design strategies, feasibility studies, material specifications, and construction design packages. Her approach blends methodical research with design thinking to deliver bespoke solutions tailored to each client’s needs. Natalie holds additional diplomas in Photography and Gender-Based Studies, enriching her creative and cultural perspective. She is proficient in British Sign Language (BSL) and is an active member of the LGBTQIA+ community—both within Jacobs and in broader society, advocating for inclusion, visibility, and equity in design and beyond. She is deeply committed to inclusive design, with a particular focus on neuro-aesthetics and equality in the built environment. Natalie champions design that not only meets rigorous standards but also enhances human experience, placing sustainability and end-user wellbeing at the heart of every project. An active presence in

name: REVA | The House of Stories
description: Neelanchana Kumar—better known simply as Neel—is the visionary founder and creative force behind REVA, a Dubai-based interior design consultancy that transforms spaces into storytelling masterpieces ( revahouseofstories.com ). Born and raised in Dubai, Neel captures the essence of the city’s cosmopolitan pulse and fuses it with her own personal narrative. With nearly 20 years of design experience, Neel has led over 400 prestigious projects across eight countries, spanning workspaces, luxury residences, retail environments, educational settings, and bespoke conceptual spaces. Her signature style? Thoughtful, timeless, visually captivating—and always sustainable. That ethos has earned REVA global accolades and industry recognition. Quick Contact 📍 REVA – The House of Stories Downtown, Dubai, UAE 📞 +971 58 562 5505 ✉️ hello@revahouseofstories.com Neel isn't afraid to call it like it is: design is serious business, but your space should feel alive—and that’s exactly what she delivers. Whether you're after bold innovation or elegant simplicity, Neel and her team at REVA bring emotional depth, storytelling flair, and unwavering excellence. Want your brand, home, or workspace to speak? Neel makes it sing.

name: Davies Creative Interiors
description: Nerissa of Davies Creative Ltd is a highly creative Interior Designer with several years experience in property renovation and high-end Interiors. Qualifications include - Residential Interior Design from KLC, (Honours) in Chelsea London, and an MA in Interactive Media form LCC London (Honours). An Art Director and Creative Interior Designer, Nerissa designs contemporary and transitional spaces with highly imaginative ideas and the ultimate development of personal style for each of her clients. The design direction of each project is progressed collaboratively, through hand sketching, technical drawing, spacial planning, lighting design, colour theory and mood board. Each client receives a design presentation, mood boards and furniture book. Sourcing furniture fixtures and fittings is a key part of the work, and procuring for the highest level of finish within the agreed budget. "My team are a trusted set of contractors and suppliers that are not only great to work with but adhere to the highset standards of finish" “The most inspiring part to my work is helping my clients develop their own sense of style, as well as proposing and presenting them with styling that has the 'wow' yet creates a sense of home.”

name: Nick Snow Design Studio
description: Nick Snow Design is an Interior Studio located in Hampshire and accredited by the British Institute of Interior Design Known for our Signature style and high quality service, our Interior Design Studio offers a comprehensive service specialising in Residential and Commercial design projects. Founded by award winning designer Nick Snow, the studio brings a wealth of experience of contemporary style and liveable design to fit our clients' lifestyles. Our Hampshire based studio offers a range services including a fully equipped Interior Design Studio, Bespoke Interior Tailoring, 3D CAD Rendering, Full Project Management along with Home Styling and Staging. Our professional insight and connections mean we are able to offer you smart and unique solutions to create the perfect outcome no matter how unusual the space may be. We design every space to the highest standards. As an established and admired creative force within the Interior Design profession, NSD Studio has developed its own unique Statement Style that is evident throughout our work. We specialise in incorporating sophisticated design with eclectic elements, and excel in bringing spaces to life for our Private Clients.

name: NS Interiors
description: NICHOLAS SUNDERLAND INTERIORS Nicholas Sunderland Interior Design was established in 2001 and quickly became recognised as one of the industry’s leading Design Consultancies. As a registered Interior Designer with the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID), and a Professional member of the Society of British and International Design, (SBID) his credentials are of the highest standard. Nicholas is also a CPD assessor for the BIID confirming only the best suppliers are recommended to the industry. Nicholas is also an external adviser for the validation of the Portsmouth University MA Interior Design Course in partnership with Cambridge Education Group (CEG). His experience and training in the Far East of Classical Feng Shui enhances his design status and creates an East-West style subtle in its approach. The client list is extensive in UK and international markets, from young couples to world leaders of industry, politicians and heads of state. Award-winning style, bespoke interiors, full renovations, interior fit-outs and furnishings are managed with ease. Equally, projects with more modest budgets are dealt with to the same standard but tailored to your individual brief and target funding. Nicholas handles all projects personally and clients have direct access during working hours. Each interior design is tailored to the individual requirements, style and budget of the client from a full interior to a single room, and the project always receives the same attention to det

name: Violet & George
description: Violet & George was founded in 2009 by Nicky Mudie, following a decade of experience in the interior design industry and a lifelong passion for textiles, craftsmanship, and considered, luxury design. With a deep-rooted understanding of soft furnishings and decorative arts, Nicky established the studio to offer beautifully tailored interiors with soul and personality. Nicky studied Textile Design at art college before completing a degree in the History of Art & Design at Leeds University. She apprenticed under Daniel Hopwood at his West London studio, then spent seven years as Head Designer at Godrich Interiors, where she played a key role in building and shaping the studio. What sets Violet & George apart is the attention we pay to what truly matters to our clients. We offer a flexible interior design and decoration service that adapts to individual needs — from full interior schemes to made-to-measure curtains and upholstery, paint and fabric consultations, intelligent lighting solutions, and signature decorative details. Working from our West London studio and soft furnishings workshop in Hampshire, our designers and skilled craftsmen collaborate with a trusted network of specialists to deliver exceptional quality and a highly personalised, joyful client experience.

name: Nicola Burt Interior Design
description: A friendly, approachable and professional interior design studio, we create super-stylish yet comfortable interiors. Beauty, function, and style are at the heart of what we do, and we have extensive design experience to help you transform your ideas into reality. We are a small but passionate team working mainly in residential and small commercial projects. Working together to create bespoke interiors tailored to you, we will help you to create a space that is functional yet beautiful, and uniquely yours. We love collaborating with clients to help them create beautiful spaces in which to live, work and play. Our belief is that good design is for everyone, and where we live and work should be happy and positive places. We want clients to get the best possible results for the time and money they invest in their project, and to enjoy the experience of transforming where they live or work.

name: Mandeville Home Ltd
description: At Mandeville Home we offer a full turnkey residential interior design service across Hertfordshire, including St Albans, Harpenden, Hitchin and the surrounding areas. Our interior design studio works closely with homeowners to create beautiful, thoughtfully designed interiors that feel personal, practical and timeless. From the first conversation to the final finishing touches, we manage the entire design process for you. Our services include interior design consultation, space planning, design development, sourcing furniture and finishes, procurement, project coordination and styling. Whether you are renovating a family home, extending a period property or furnishing a new build, we guide you every step of the way, making the experience enjoyable and stress-free. Based in Hertfordshire, we pride ourselves on delivering bespoke interior design solutions that reflect how you live and what matters most to you. Our turnkey approach means every detail is carefully considered and beautifully brought together, so you can relax and enjoy a home that truly feels like yours.

name: Nicola O'Mara Interior Design
description: Nicola O’Mara is one of the leading home renovation experts in Cornwall. She is an award winning interior designer with more than 18 years experience remodeling the homes, ski chalets, new builds and holiday houses of successful professionals in and around the Polzeath, Rock, Cornwall, the South West but also internationally. Nicola is highly knowledgeable in interiors and is involved in every aspect of remodeling; from drawing plans to managing contractors, to over seeing the design and construction detailling. She is a specialist in new build, renovation work and project managing the design and installation process. She is known for her attention to detail and her outstanding client service. Clients use phases such as, extremely reliable, knowledgeable, professional, provides great solutions and highly recommended to describe her. She is fully envolved in all of her projects including clients and contractors meetings, furniture and material specification and coordination. “ I strive to make the process less stressful for our clients”, “ I love that I can help clients make important design decisions early in the build process, which can avoid costly mistakes later on’. Nicola started her business back in 1998 and as worked on a large variety of projects, from coastal homes, penthouse apartments, townhouses, period cottages, through to bespoke ski properties and large wooden lodges. Nicola has built up a large network of talented artisans, contractors, joinery & cabinet maker

name: Nikki Rees Interior Design
description: With over two decades of industry experience, Nikki creates interiors that are as emotionally resonant as they are beautifully functional. Her work spans both residential and commercial spaces, united by a belief that every environment, whether a family home or a place of business, has the potential to enrich wellbeing and express identity. Nikki has a gift for translating her clients’ values, stories, and aspirations into spaces that feel authentic, timeless, and deeply human. She understands both the emotional and financial investment behind each project and approaches every design with great care, integrity, and attention to detail. Nikki began her design journey with a BA in Interior Design from Kingston University in 2000, followed by experience in fashion, retail, and exhibition design. This multidisciplinary foundation shaped her ability to blend space, aesthetics, and function into cohesive, beautifully considered interiors. Her style is calm, layered, and thoughtful, often combining muted tones and natural textures to create spaces that feel effortless, grounded, and quietly elevated. Known for her collaborative and detail-focused approach, Nikki has built a reputation for trust, excellence, and designs that stand the test of time. Since founding her studio in 2013, her practice has grown organically through word-of-mouth, reflecting the lasting relationships and delight she cultivates with every client. Above all, Nikki’s mission is simple: to design spaces that tel

name: Nina Lancaster Interior Design
description: Nina Lancaster Interior Design is based in Hertfordshire and works with clients throughout East Anglia and The Cotswolds. Nina is KLC School of Design trained and established the design practice in 2020. We create relaxed interiors with an emphasis on elegant and timeless design. Whilst leaning towards a neutral palette, we love to combine a pop of colour alongside natural hues and textures to create a balanced and layered look. When considering a design scheme, we spend time getting to know our clients to fully understand how they live and what they enjoy. “Working closely with clients helps me to understand their needs which then enables me to create a balanced and harmonious design to ensure their home flows beautifully. Your home should look and feel good. It's your haven, so it needs to feel calm and welcoming as soon as your walk in the door." says our founder, Nina. We can work closely with your project team or can provide you with everything you need to implement your design scheme.

name: No Ordinary House
description: Nichola McKerrow Todd is the Founder and Creative Director of No Ordinary House , a London-based interior design studio specialising in thoughtfully guided residential renovations with a strong focus on wellbeing. With a background in architecture and marketing, Nichola is known for combining design expertise with clear, grounded communication — supporting clients both practically and emotionally throughout complex projects. Her work is characterised by a calm, layered aesthetic, biophilic influences, and the considered use of natural materials to create homes that feel restorative, balanced, and deeply personal. Having experienced major renovations personally as well as professionally, she understands the uncertainty and decision fatigue homeowners often face, and brings structure, reassurance, and clarity to each stage of the process. Her work has received industry recognition, including being a runner-up at the ufurnish Awards and shortlisted for the British Home Awards and the SBID Awards. She is the creator of Living Through a Renovation , a guide designed to help homeowners feel steadier and better prepared as they navigate ambitious home transformations. Nichola’s work centres on the belief that great design is not just about how a space looks, but how it supports wellbeing and everyday life.

name: Nomad Private Client Ltd
description: Our Private Client service combines award winning interior design with the rigour of real world project delivery. Drawing on years of experience crafting our own projects, we offer a level of project management few design studios can match. Every home is overseen by our dedicated in-house team. From early design detailing to full site coordination and final dressing. The result is a beautifully executed, highly personalised home, and a process that feels seamless from start to finish.

name: CasaNora
description: Having studied Fashion Design in AIU (American University in London) I started my career in fashion designing evening wear and wedding dresses. In 2007 I decided to work in property development and Interiors which led me to KLC ( school of design) which then started my career in Interiors. I have specialised in kitchen design which also allows me to create a stylish yet comfortable open plan spaces. In 2014 I opened my showroom in Putney SW15. My passion is space planning and to create a stylish, unique, luxurious yet practical home designed especially for you to enjoy. I love experimenting with textures and colours to create continuous harmony throughout , you will feel gradual transition of colour from one room to the next with special attention to the mood and balance in that space. Whether your home is modern or traditional my priority is to offer you a full design service for all your needs. I will take care of everything for you to the finest detail; from the largest piece of furniture to the smallest dining accessories. All you need to do is enjoy the experience of creating your own timeless and beautiful home.

name: BABID
description: Born in Japan, she graduated from Meiji University with degrees in geography and museum studies. Her career began with CA, where she explored 40 cities across 30 countries. She then transitioned to a hotel consultancy role in Tokyo for 10 years, where she was involved in the opening project of the prestigious Hotel Seiyo Ginza. In 1995, she moved to the UK. After receiving specialized training in architecture and interior design at The Interior Design School and the UCL Bartlett, she founded her own business in London. From 2000 to 2017, her projects encompassed various sectors, including residential spaces (ranging from 100 m² to 1,400 m²), hotels, restaurants, show flats, and furniture design, both in Japan and the UK. In 2012, she launched a professional e-learning college for Japanese professionals. For her contributions to BIID, her work in education, and her outstanding design achievements, she received the BIID Merit Award in 2016, becoming the 8th recipient out of 1,200 members. In 2017, she returned to Japan, where her first major accomplishment was establishing the BIID Japan Chapter in 2018, marking the first branch located outside the UK. Following the success of the inaugural BIID overseas event at the British Embassy in Tokyo in 2009, she has organized numerous promotional events and recruited around 40 top Japanese designers as BIID members. The organisation is now recognized as one of the most prestigious professional associations for interior design in Japan.

name: Novaco Design Ltd
description: Novaco Design is a full-service interior architecture and design firm dedicated to creating spaces that are not only beautiful but functional and reflective of our client's unique personalities and lifestyles. We work closely with our clients to understand their needs and bring their vision to life. We believe that good design should enhance the quality of life and our goal is to create spaces that inspire and delight. From conceptual design to project management, we handle every aspect of the design process to ensure that our clients receive the highest level of service and the best possible outcome. At Novaco Design, we are passionate about creating innovative and timeless design solutions that meet the unique needs and preferences of our clients. We have extensive experience in a wide range of projects, from residential to commercial, hospitality to retail. So, whether you're looking to redesign a single room or an entire home, Novaco Design has the expertise and experience to bring your vision to life. Let us help you create the space of your dreams.

name: House of Nur Ltd
description: Nur Alnajafi Interior designer provides a full interior, furnishing design services & consultation services. Creating tailored projects that are timeless, liveable & authentic, each project meet clients vision & no two projects are the same. working with each client very closely, building strong ongoing relationship to provide personal & adaptable services. ensuring to provide project that are practical & beautiful. with UK & International portfolio, recent & ongoing project include houses in Jordan, Iraq, Saudi Arabia & Turkey, coffee shops & restaurants in UK & Jordan, Hospitality projects in UK in addition to offices in Saudi Arabia & UK. Ambitious with strong organizational and multitasking skills, as well as an aptitude for technology. Ready to apply knowledge and skills to any challenge. Detailoriented professional with excellent communication, interpersonal, and creative thinking skills.

name: Octavia Dickinson
description: Octavia is known for her joyful, decorative style and instinctive use of colour, pattern and texture. After studying History of Art at the Courtauld Institute, she trained with some of the country’s leading decorators before founding her studio in 2018. She is currently recognised by House and Garden as one of the Top 100 Interior Designers in the UK and by Country and Town House as one of the Top 50 Best Interior Designers . Her projects span town and country, from a London pieds-à-terre to Grade 1 stately homes, Octavia works across residential and commercial interiors, bringing the same thoughtful eye and relaxed, personal approach to every brief. Growing up Octavia was surrounded by art and antiques which shaped her love of beautiful, well-made things. Today, she combines that sensibility with a fresh, light touch to create homes that feel warm, individual and quietly expressive. In 2022, she launched her debut collection of fabrics and wallpapers, drawing on her archive of vintage textiles, ceramics and favourite objects. Each design reflects her enduring belief: that the most beautiful homes are those that feel lived in and loved.

name: Ola Jachymiak Studio LTD
description: Having graduated from a technical interior design university in Gliwice, Poland, Ola decided to move to Paris, where she worked for a prominent design studio for 7 years.In 2013 she started her own Design Studio powered by her desire to work with clients in a more direct and personal manner. She wanted to move away from being just another designer in a big interior design studio and create a place where she could treat each project as a haute couture work. Ola prides herself on being immersed and present at all stages of the studio’s project. Starting from completely changing the layouts of the aerial space throughout the choice of a wallpaper, furniture and even tableware. Now living in London, Ola is successfully continuing her work and commitment to bring excellency and custom made approach to all her clients.

name: Space Shack
description: Discarding meaningless decoration, Founder & Creative Director Omar Bhatti puts more emphasis on the relationship between people, culture, activities and environment and knows clever spatial configuration like no one else. Establishing a sense of spaciousness, optimising comfort and convenience and enhancing daylight penetration Omar has transformed projects and united spaces across London and beyond. After studying architecture at London Met, Omar started his career in a small architecture firm but quickly shifted his career path to interiors. Forging his own path in 2016, Omar and his team have completed dozens of full renovations and interior design projects in London, adapting complex and frustrating spaces for purposeful use. Today, Space Shack juggles luxury projects that run the gamut from minimalist contemporary to idiosyncratic flash, always staying true to the client’s individual style and personality, whilst the essence of Space Shack is woven in throughout the design journey.

name: Architects Hub
description: Omeima Osman is an architect and interior designer with over 20 years experience. She holds a Master's degree in architectural design management from the Instituto de Empresa in Spain. Having lived in Qatar for over 25 years, Omeima has worked as architect in both the private sector as consultant and the public sector as client representative. Her most recent position was senior researcher at Qatar Foundation.
