Before that she held the positions of architect - design project manager at the Qatar Olympic Committee and lead architect in Doha Asian Games Organizing Committee. You can see here LinkedIn profile on this link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/omeimaosman/

name: Ham Interiors Ltd
description: Our approachable and experienced in house team offer a range of services from interior design, build and project management, to helping our clients source one-off pieces to make their properties unique. We place our clients needs at the heart of the design process, working closely to given briefs, budgetary and style requirements. We work in the Countryside, in Towns & Cities covering a wide catchment area with projects in progress all over the South East and further afield.

name: Paola Leon Design
description: Paola Leon Design is an award winning studio of designers based in Central London. We work at all scales from high end commercial projects, to luxury private homes and furnishing. The studio has a background in taking a holistic design approach to deliver large projects for high profile clients domestically and internationally. We create bespoke interiors that are both functional and beautiful with a strong sense of place and purpose. Meeting the client needs at every step of the process. The interiors we deliver are elegant, functional and thoughtful, designs that convey a sense of place, whether the style is classical, contemporary or eclectic. If required we can design and create bespoke furniture and joinery, working alongside artisans throughout the design process to ensure they achieve the quality of craftsmanship that each project deserves. Where appropriate, we love to reflect and incorporate the design, history and character of the building itself. It is important to let the personal journey the building has lived be reflected and shine through, revitalising itself for a new chapter. This experience and expertise allows PLD to deliver high quality design across a range of disciplines, including: Interior Design - Architecture - Fit Out - Furniture and Joinery Design - Spatial Organisation - FF&E Procurement - Home Dressing and Art Direction.

name: Yiangou Architects Ltd
description: Interior Design Philosophy I am particularly interested in the architectural and contextual value of a particular space. Ideas are often generated from an architectural feature or a particular characteristic or feeling of a space along side meeting the clients brief. The key feature may not necessarily be within the room it could be a view or vista. Another main objective, equally important, relates to the more practical requirements of organising layouts appropriate for use and life style. It is always important to balance the values of practicality with the aesthetics. Along side this I believe a space needs to feel personal to the client, they have to feel ownership of their space, to adopt it and inhabit it. The process we go through will be an evolution of discussions and ideas. A home is deeply personal. At Yiangou Interiors we specialise in all aspects of Interior design. We feel we are particularly strong at space planning, allowing you to maximise the potential of your space. We will generally create and agree layouts and then provide working drawings, including lighting and electrical layouts. In most projects we will research, agree and specify all the finishes, the bathroom layouts and sanitary ware specifications. We design and procure bespoke items of joinery, including kitchens, dressing rooms, wine cellars etc. We then can oversee the installation of these items on site. Alongside this we provide interior schemes, proposing colours, fabrics, window treatments,

name: Paul Fishpool Design Ltd
description: I am an award winning Interior Designer whose work is recognised for its simplicity, elegance and comfort. Over a career spanning more than 15 years, I have had the good fortune to hone my skills at some of London’s most renowned design Studios such as Candy & Candy and Taylor Howes Designs. My last role prior to founding my own Studio, was to establish & lead the Interior Design department at Rigby & Rigby, for which we received 3 Awards in the first 2 years. With a degree in Architecture from Kingston University & a Diploma in Interior Design from KLC School of Design, I am well placed to balance the differing elements of an interiors scheme, from the initial spatial review to the final decorative flourishes. I approach each project from a completely fresh perspective, but I always look to create timeless Interiors which are as usable as they are elegant and which emphasise my fundamental belief that the biggest luxury in life is comfort.

name: Paula Morrison Interiors Ltd
description: Paula Morrison Interiors is a boutique design studio based in Surrey, serving clients across the county and South West London. We specialise in creating sophisticated, bespoke residential spaces that harmonise timeless elegance with modern functionality. From the leafy enclaves of the Surrey Hills to the refined townhouses of Richmond and Wimbledon, our studio provides a comprehensive, detail-oriented service tailored to each client’s unique aspirations. We take pride in our commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and curated aesthetics, ensuring every project - whether a full-scale renovation or a single-room transformation - results in a home that is as beautiful as it is timeless.

name: Paulette Stephens Interior Design
description: Paulette Stephens Interior Design creates residential and commercial environments which combine personality, style and functionality. Working with architectural partners and contractors across a variety of residential and commercial interiors, Paulette draws on art, design and fashion to create engaging contemporary spaces.Established in 2012, the studio continues to grow, working on projects in London, Nationally and Internationally.

name: Hill House Interiors Ltd
description: Peter has been registered as an architect since 2003 and also became a BIID registered Interior Desigjer in November 2017. He has a wide range of experience working for various high-profile architectural and interior design companies in Glasgow, London, Weybridge, Winchester and Windsor. Peter joined Hill House Interiors in January 2022.

name: Peter Staunton Design Studio
description: Peter Staunton Design is an Interior Architecture, Design and Decoration studio dedicated to shaping modern living for our discerning clients. Blending intelligent spatial design with a fearless use of colour and the finest raw materials, we guide clients confidently beyond their comfort zone, creating spaces that are built to last and inspire for years. Peter holds the conviction that effective design has the power to uplift the human spirit, enriching daily experiences and well-being in the environments we dwell in. Our meticulous editing process for each project aims to maximise the core elements, minimising waste and showcasing space and design at its finest. Our goal is to craft truly iconic interiors that transcend time and fleeting trends, inspire its owners, and leave a lasting legacy for future generations. “Craftsmanship, materiality and fine detailing are the principle's we embrace”. Heavily influenced by music, fashion & art, juxtaposed with a passion for classic & contemporary architecture, Peter aims to bridge the gap between these creative arts & integrate them to create a look he likes to phrase as ‘Raw Luxury, Refined Design’. Services include:- Design & Concept. Interior Space Planning. 3D & CGI Rendering. Project Management. Furniture Design & Production. Cabinetry Design & Production. Lighting Design. Full SMart Home Technology. Bespoke Soft Furnishings. Full Decoration Servics. Installation & Staging For any enquiries, please email info@peterstaunton.co.u

name: Studio 44 Design
description: Headed by Philippa Buckley, Studio 44 has as its central focus the creation of unique interiors; with offices in both Dublin and London. Philippa specialises in high end residential interior architectural and design for with over twenty years of experience working with private clients. Renowned for expert design advice, creativity and a highly collaborative approach, the studio transforms houses into beautifully considered homes. Backed by a trusted team, Studio 44 Design delivers thoughtfully executed projects on time and within budget. Studio 44 Design is a creative design company dedicated to shaping distinctive, character-driven spaces. With a strong design-led approach, the studio carefully considers every element of a project, from bespoke furniture pieces to thoughtfully curated lighting design. Each space is crafted to feel unique and immersive, balancing imagination with functionality. Through layered lighting, refined materials, and carefully selected furnishings, Studio 44 Design creates environments rich in ambience—spaces that not only look beautiful but also evoke mood, atmosphere, and a lasting sense of place.For more information please check out our website www.studio44.ie

name: Devas Designs
description: Philippa Devas, is an experienced interior designer whose distinctive style blends traditional with modern, old with new. She is a member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID). Philippa began working for Percy Bass, then became an assistant to Chester Jones at Colefax & Fowler, before working at Chester's own company where she honed her natural talent and eye for space, proportion, light and texture. Devas Designs was established in 1998 and Philippa has since worked on many diverse projects from large country houses to modern London flats, carving out a successful niche for the company. Philippa was placed in the House & Garden Directory of the 100 Leading Interior Designers 2006, 2009, 2012 and 2015. She was also nominated for an Amara Interior Blog Award in 2016 for her busy blog about interiors, art and design. Philippa creates interiors combining practicality with a chic, muted style and works closely with clients using existing architectural elements as a starting point. Philippa also sources furniture, paintings and works of art for clients either as a one-off or as part of a design project.

name: Thorp Design Limited
description: Thorp Design is a distinguished London-based architecture and interior design studio, proudly celebrating over 40 years of excellence. Founded by Philippa Thorp, the practice brings together a highly skilled team of interior designers and architects who have earned a reputation for delivering timeless, bespoke projects across the UK and internationally. Renowned for its personal and collaborative approach, Thorp Design works on a broad range of commissions—from elegant city apartments and country estates to yachts, private planes, and even horse boxes. Whether transforming existing structures or designing from the ground up, the studio’s work is defined by an uncompromising attention to detail and a commitment to authenticity. Every project is unique, tailored to reflect the client’s individual style and lifestyle needs. Philippa Thorp’s curatorial expertise, particularly in sourcing and placing fine art and antiques, adds another layer of distinction to the studio’s work. Many clients return to Thorp for repeat projects in their additional residences, a testament to the trust, creativity, and meticulous service that define the studio’s offering. In addition to private commissions, Thorp is well known for landmark commercial projects including the acclaimed KX Gym in South Kensington and Wentworth Golf Club. Across all work, the studio’s hallmark is clear: every space is crafted with timeless elegance, intelligent design, and a personal touch that makes it feel both refined a

name: Pia Design Ltd
description: A love of nature is at the heart of our designs and our philosophy is that the best form of sustainability is a carefully considered scheme and the use of quality materials - natural materials have a timeless quality about them that surpasses trends whilst also standing the test of time: some materials even grow more beautiful with age. Everything we do has the future of our home planet at its heart, and we actively champion more sustainable ways to remodel. We reuse, repurpose and refurbish before replacing. We believe longevity is the best form of sustainability and by taking inspiration from nature we’re able to create spaces that improve with age. Spaces that grow with you and your family. Interiors with a green soul.

name: Brahm Interiors
description: Pierre Brahm established Brahm Interiors eleven years ago with a vision to create a design team offering experience in a wealth of disciplines, combined with creative flair. With over 30 years experience in both the residential and commercial sectors, the Brahm design team has worked on projects ranging from luxury private homes to large-scale investment portfolios. Offering a range of services from property dressing, planning and design, to full refurbishment, Brahm Interiors is equipped to fulfill your every requirement. Working with design conscious home-owners, developers and property agents, our accolades include winning the Design & Decoration Award for Best Show Home, being short-listed for a British Interior Designer Award, and Quintessentially Interior Designer of the Year 2010.

name: Pippa Paton Design Limited
description: Focussed on the Cotswolds, Pippa Paton is a highly respected and visionary interior designer specialising in high-end residential projects. Known for transforming manor houses, estates, and barns, Pippa’s approach is consistent: an unwavering focus on the bones of the structure that reflect the unique character of the region and blending these seamlessly with contemporary materials to create timeless, luxurious homes. Using her instinctive ability to visualise what a space can be and how to optimise its potential for the lives we lead today, over the past two decades Pippa and her team have successfully reconfigured many historic (and more recently constructed) homes for life in the 21st-century, navigating projects through planning, construction and fit-out, exposing and enhancing historic features along the way and introducing colours, textures, furniture and art to create interiors of calm simplicity. Pippa is internationally recognised having won multiple awards and featured in leading interiors publications worldwide. She has been included in Country Life's Top 100 every year since its inception in 2017 and in Andrew Martin's Top 100 Designers in the World several times, as well as publishing two books, 'Twenty First Century Cotswolds' Volumes I & II.

name: Free Birds Interior Design Studio Ltd
description: Free Birds Interior Design Studio was created from an ambition that started years ago. I have always loved beautiful spaces and worked for many years marketing the luxury boutique hotel industry where I always found myself more drawn to the Interiors than the marketing. After a career break raising my girls, I was privileged to find a position in a well-established design studio and after five years learning the intricacies of the trade, I decided to start my own studio. The passion for beautiful interiors has never been stronger. People today have come to appreciate the intense pleasure of living or working in a space that they love and have helped create. I would love nothing more than working closely with clients on projects and turn their dream home into a reality. I work from my home office in South London and cover projects in Central and South London.

name: RACHEL LAXER
description: Rachel was born and raised in New York and has travelled the world extensively, including living in Tokyo and Europe for a number of years ; providing an international perspective for the interiors she creates. She currently divides her time between a New York home, and London - where she lives with her husband and two young daughters. Prior to launching her career in London at Kelly Hoppen Interiors, she was a successful Emerging Markets trader and portfolio manager in the Hedge Fund industry for several large global funds. She has an undergraduate degree in Political Science and History from Washington University in St. Louis, as well as a Master' s in Business Administration in Finance from New York University.

name: London Atelier Ltd
description: Ralf Eikelberg PGDip (ENG) Interior Architecture, reg. BIID Interior Designer, PGDip Architecture UCL London, reg. Architekt in AK-Berlin Ralf Eikelberg studied and practised as an Interior Architect in Germany before graduating from the Bartlett with a Post Graduate Diploma in Architecture. He was a senior member of established design lead Architect's practices before becoming a co-director of London Atelier in 2010. Ralf specialised in designing within the existing and new build sectors, remodelling and working on listed buildings at various scales. London Atelier's meticulous eye for detail, construction and innovation combined with the appropriate materiality and custom solutions is a trade mark of their designs. The client brief is paramount. Every project is unique and deserves the best possible design solution to enable and unlock its full potential. Before his time in London, he was involved in architectural practices and a lighting design firm based in Berlin. Further, he has worked with the Italian Architect Paolo Portoghesi in Rome. Ralf has been involved in high-profile projects ranging from residential buildings and exhibitions to commercial projects. These projects included the London Library, News International London, St. Marylebone School extension, the Hauser+Wirth Gallery in London and the new Centre Pompidou Metz, France. Several projects won numerous awards, including the National RIBA Awards for public and private buildings, steel and concrete awards and

name: RD Design
description: For over 20 years Rachel Davies has been providing interior design services to clients in London, Warwickshire and the Cotswolds. Having built her reputation by recommendation Rachel has extensive experience in renovating and breathing new life into historical properties whilst creating modern country homes that reflect a playful use of period style influences. Rachel’s understanding of scale and proportion, coupled with meticulous attention to detail, results in the creation of inspirational spaces that feel timeless and appropriate to place.

name: Renata Drumond Interior Design
description: Based in Cambridge and working across the UK and internationally, Renata Drumond Interior Design is a studio known for creating bespoke, beautifully balanced interiors that blend timeless elegance with a modern sensibility. With a background in architecture, Renata brings a technical understanding of space, proportion, and light to every project, ensuring each design feels both effortless and deeply considered. Her work is defined by calm, layered palettes, natural materials, and refined detailing — always tailored to reflect the individuality of her clients and the way they live. The studio offers a fully integrated interior architecture and design service, covering every stage from concept to completion. Projects span private residences, listed buildings, and international homes, with services including spatial planning, bespoke joinery, lighting design, FF&E specification, and styling. Collaboration lies at the heart of the studio’s approach. Renata works closely with artisans, makers, and specialist suppliers to achieve interiors that combine craftsmanship with understated luxury. Every project is delivered with the same care, whether a single room or a large-scale renovation. For Renata, great design is about creating spaces that feel timeless, personal, and grounded — places that are as beautiful to live in as they are to look at.

name: Residence Interior Design
description: We’re an interior design and architectural design studio. We specialise in private client residential projects and luxury developments across London and the South of England. Since 2007, we’ve been designing refined, elegant interiors for contemporary and period homes. You can see in our interior design portfolio that every project is different, and each client is unique – that’s what makes this work so rewarding to us. I believe that the architectural design and interior decoration of our homes can have a powerful influence on our lives and wellbeing. Home is where we spend so much time – it’s the backdrop to our busy lives. It’s where we want to relax and entertain. It’s where we welcome others, it’s where we want to feel most ourselves. Our home influences how we do things, how well we’re able to do them and most importantly – how we feel at the time. It’s a feeling that doesn’t happen by accident – it comes from careful, smart, tailored design, which takes on board who you are, what you need, what you want and what you hope for. Seeing people’s delight, surprise and happiness at the work we do, at a space transformed, at the difference in how their home makes them feel – is why we do what we do. We create unique homes which feel just right. This might be creating a sense of calm through simplicity or the feeling of comfort through luxury; it might be creating a sense of ‘wow’ through bold choices and small details which add up to a big impression. It might be bringing sim

name: Accouter Design (AGofC)
description: For more than a decade, I have been designing high-end, luxury interior design projects for high net worth clients both in London and internationally. I'm a passionate designer. I care about creating beautifully considered spaces that exceed a client's expectations. With a background in Interior Architecture I design residential properties from when they are still a hole in the ground, all the way through to selecting the last cushion on the sofa. Accouter Design was launched in 2012, it is now an award-winning studio and one of London's fastest growing companies. We have clients approach us from all over the world because we have a proven track record of providing a full white glove service tailored to all of their indiviudal design requirements. My role as Design Director is to ensure we are designing innovative projects that is at the forefront of creative thinking. AGC is home to Accouter Design, A.LONDON by Accouter, BoxNine7, and is based in Mayfair.

name: Richard Lankester Design Consultants - RLDC
description: At RLDC we have an holistic approach to Interior Design which encompasses careful consideration to the given environment for function, form and a client's individual personality and requirements. We believe that an interior must perform as well as it looks. Architectural details and finishes evolve from the perspective of the project at hand. Quality, comfort and craftsmanship are essential. Our preference for clean lines with uncluttered simplicity and natural elements is evident in our projects. A space should feel relaxed, comfortable and unpretentious in its completion. We aspire to produce considered, authentic and durable designs through a dialogue between ourselves and the client which creates ongoing trust and relationships.

name: Rigby & Rigby Ltd
description: Paul has fifteen years professional experience in Architectural Practice and has been involved in a number of projects across a variety of sectors, including education, pharmaceutical, aviation, R&D and high-end residential. Paul carries professional accreditation with both the RIBA (Royal Institute of British Architects) & BIID (British Institute of Interior Designers). In 2014, Paul joined Rigby & Rigby and has since gained extensive experience in the delivery of highly complex planning/LBC applications, along with the preparation of detailed/technical design packages, project management and interior scheme proposals for a number of properties within Super Prime London. Recent projects include the award winning 12 Charles Street apartment, R&R's spectacular Grosvenor Square development, along with a selection of exceptional Private Client projects. Paul's expertise lies in the analysis of complex functions and creation of robust [considered] design solutions which respond elegantly to the client's aspirations.

name: Design Emporium Ltd
description: Design Emporium provides architectural, interior design and project management, specialising in private residences. Established in 2003, the company has developed a reputation for achieving the highest levels of design, quality and service. Since its inception, Design Emporium has put the client’s lifestyle and requirements at the centre of its design. Gaining a detailed insight into our clients has allowed us to build a strong reputation for bespoke design that creates a unique and functional space to meet their requirements. As the business has expanded our ethos has transferred into commercial projects too, designing and delivering individual projects across various sectors. Achieving our vision is made possible through established and close working relationships with suppliers, contractors and craftsman. In the past decade we have carefully expanded these relationships to develop a multi skilled team capable of implementing our projects.

name: Vastu Design
description: London based interior designer, Rina Patel has over 20 years of experience in the luxury residential sector, both in the UK and abroad, and founded her company Vastu Design in 1999. It is Rina's passion for art and design combined with her respect for the construction industry and tradespeople that informs her interior design work. Her approach to every project is first and foremost about understanding her client's lifestyle and aesthetics. Once this is established, she develops an interior design scheme to reflect their needs and desires. The end result are luxury environments defined by well laid out space, attention to detail, refined materials and sophisticated colour palettes. Rina is described as a people's person, approachable and easy to work with among clients and design professionals alike. She has exceptional project management skills including a minute attention to detail, strong planning and organization, and total efficiency throughout each and every phase.

name: Roselind Wilson Design LTD
description: Roselind Wilson Design is an award-winning, luxury interior architecture and interior design studio specialising in top end residential and hospitality projects in the UK and abroad. With combined industry experience that spans three decades, our team of dynamic and experienced designers and luxury experts bring a host of skills to the table, are passionate about their work and are focused to thoughtfully interpret and deliver a diverse scope of briefs across residential, corporate and hospitality projects. Our studio is a bustling creative hub where there is a sense of collaboration between the team, with openness for freedom of expression. This honesty and openness carries through to the relationships we form with our distinctive clients and lies at the core of what we do. We approach each brief individually by getting to know our clients, nurturing their personal style and embarking on the design journey together. Recent awards includes United Kingdom Property Awards 2019-2020: Interior Design Private Residence London; United Kingdom Property Awards 2017-2018: Best Interior Design Private Residence London and UK; The International Design & Architecture Awards 2017: Kitchen Design over £100,000; kbbreview Retail & Design Awards 2017: Kitchen Designer of the Year (Project cost over £50k) and Bathroom Designer of the Year (Project cost over £25k), London Design Awards 2016: Silver Winner - Interior Design Residential, UK Property Awards 2014-2015: Best Interior Design Apartme

name: Ward & Co.
description: Sarah and Rosie Ward are a mother-daughter interior design duo from London. With over 35 years of experience and a number of design awards, they are dedicated to creating soulful spaces that feel authentic and deeply connected to their clients. Each project presents an opportunity to tell a unique story, shaped by an intimate understanding of individual tastes and needs. Their bespoke approach emphasises getting to know clients, ensuring every space is both personal and meaningful.

name: Clifton Interiors
description: At Clifton Interiors we create original, beautiful, contemporary interiors that are both sophisticated and practical. Founded in 1986, Clifton Interiors have a wealth of experience in luxury residential interiors. We provide comprehensive interior design and architectural services.

name: Jon Frullani Architect Ltd.
description: Rosie is a senior interior designer with over 20 years of experience delivering thoughtful, bespoke solutions across residential and commercial projects. Known for her approachable and collaborative style, she places listening at the heart of her process, creating interiors that are both individual and responsive to each client’s needs. Her portfolio spans a diverse range of properties, from heritage buildings to modern and contemporary spaces, reflecting a sensitive yet distinctive design approach. Jon Frullani Architect, a Chartered Practice based in Dundee, is guided by the principle of Architecture with People in Mind, ensuring every design is both functional and meaningful.

name: Rumi Bunya Design Ltd
description: Rumi Bunya Design is an architecture-led interior design studio creating thoughtful, individual homes. Each project begins with curiosity and collaboration, resulting in spaces that feel considered, authentic and genuinely connected to the people who live in them. Rumi's perspective has been shaped by an international life across Japan, Los Angeles, London and the wider UK. Growing up in Japan has had a lasting influence on the way she thinks about space — from efficiency and thoughtful organisation to balance, practicality and the relationship between a home and everyday wellbeing. These principles inform the way she designs rather than defining a particular aesthetic; every interior responds individually to its architecture, setting and inhabitants.

name: Studio Milne
description: Ruth Milne is an interior designer and founder of Studio Milne, a London-based interior design studio specialising in residential interiors and boutique commercial spaces. With over 20 years’ experience in the design industry, Ruth creates thoughtful, characterful interiors that balance aesthetics, practicality and longevity. Her approach begins with understanding the building, the people who will inhabit it and how the space needs to function. Working collaboratively with clients, architects, contractors and craftspeople, Ruth guides projects from initial concept through to detailed design and implementation. Her work is characterised by a considered use of colour, texture and materials, alongside carefully designed details and bespoke elements. The result is a cohesive and individual interior that feels considered, comfortable and enduring — a space that reflects the people who use it and supports everyday life.

name: The Responsible Designer
description: The Responsible Designer is a sustainably minded interior architecture and design service dedicated to creating spaces that deliver positive impact to people, businesses that are mindful to the environment. Our role is to see the big picture through your eyes and use our experience to extract and translate your vision into a tangible concept we can hone together to meet your specific needs. Helping you on your journey to make your vision a reality.

name: Sally Dernie Limited
description: Sally Dernie has been delivering meticulous interiors for her busy professional clients since 2003. Her approach is to support the client in defining exactly what they would like for their home and then ensuring delivery with carefully curated details to create a perfect refuge. Her designs are intelligent, witty and sophisticated and delivered in stages for a tailor-made result. After a successful career as a lawyer Sally retrained in 2000 as an interior designer, graduating from one of the country's leading design schools, KLC. She then continued to full membership of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID). Sally specialises in working with professionals, tuning her services around their demanding jobs and allowing enough time for busy people to be involved in the design of their home so that the final work is completely in tune with their personality and lifestyle. The practice has been purposefully designed to ensure that Sally can lead each project personally for her clients providing consistent communication. Since 2003 the team of suppliers and contractors has been rigorously tested to ensure smooth delivery and exceptional finish. The interior design service is flexible and could be for an individual room, groups of rooms, or a whole house. Sally's approach ensures that the home is completed in stages over a period of time so that the design looks and feels enduring, durable and lasting. Treasured furniture, collections, libraries and artworks are also incorp

name: Salvatore Fabio
description: SALVATORE FABIO offers a full menu of services to fulfill all design needs of both commercial and residential clients.From initial concept to installation, every phase of the project is taken care of with great passion, knowledge and attention to detail. ​ ​

name: Trindade & Bird
description: Its start with a dream You are at the centre of everything we do because it’s your dream that matters. We will take that dream and transform your home with the practical magic that enriches lives. We are a highly-experienced lifestyle-centred company that listens, distils and interprets, in order to elevate and enrich peoples’ lives. Trindade and Bird is where your dreams take flight.

name: Samantha Bartlett Interiors
description: Whether your requirement is a full renovation or to simply add some finishing touches, Samantha Bartlett InterIorS will provide a warm welcoming hand to your project. Their works are imbued with a sense of calm and serenity, encompassing the client’s personality to form an inviting refuge from the outside world.

name: Samantha Johnson Design
description: Homes with soul, designed with devotion. Warm, witty and welcoming, Samantha Johnson Design creates beautiful and unique homes full of character. Taking inspiration from a deeper insight into you – your family, your lifestyle, your priorities, your passions – Samantha’s designs uncover the soul of your home, and make it fit you perfectly. Drawing on more than 25 years’ experience across a huge range of different style properties, Samantha’s work is not only about visual impact but also liveability. By focusing on spacial planning, her designs bring a sense of order and calm to even the busiest of homes, making everyday living a joy. Her designs support the flow of your daily routines, are easier to manage and maintain and are built to last, adapting to the rigours of an ever-changing family life. Across Samantha’s work, you’ll find an emphasis on textures and patterns, a love of natural materials and a mischievous sense of humour, especially when it comes to finding personalised finishing touches. Samantha takes full responsibility for every project, from concept through construction and commissioning to completion. That commitment means taking care of the finest details, managing contractors and your budget scrupulously and minimising disruption to you. Many of her projects have been in the Home Counties and London, where she has been based for the majority of her career, but her work has taken her much further afield, to Spanish villas, Swiss chalets and beach houses in Cor

name: LXA London
description: Sammy is an Associate Designer at LXA London with years of experience in the design world both as an architect and an interior designer. Each commission attracts a bespoke approach and we consistently strive to ensure that we always create timeless designs incorporating the latest technologies and sustainable materials wherever we can. We offer design services across Hospitality, Wellness and Education sectors: + Fully understand the client brief and objectives + Confirm the design and operational direction + Develop the design into presentation formats + Co-ordinate the design with co-consultants + Agree procurement strategies + Prepare full interior design drawings and specification packages + Respond to pre and post-tender queries + Monitor adherence to the design parameters during the construction phase

name: Sandra Flashman Studio
description: Sandra Flashman Studio designs London homes that feel open and calm. Every project is built around a life being lived: a love of books, food, travel, music and art, blended into a space that moves with the everyday. The studio's signature is character within a warm minimal interior: period features reworked in a contemporary way, architecture opened up to enhance light and flow, and layers of texture that make a room feel calm and open, yet rich with detail. Sandra Flashman has over 20 years' experience designing interiors across residential, hospitality and workplace projects, from full home renovations and architectural extensions to offices, and restaurants. She was recently named one of Homes & Gardens' 25 Next in Design. With a Bachelor of Architecture from the Rhode Island School of Design and a Masters from Central Saint Martins, she brings both technical and creative grounding to every commission. Her work includes offices for Virgin Holidays and Sky, restaurants for the W Hotel, and cabin interiors for Lufthansa, alongside a D&AD Yellow Pencil award. As Sarah Spiteri of Homes & Gardens puts it: "It's not easy to blend architectural period details with a flair for contemporary design, but Sandra bridges the divide perfectly."

name: Cussons + Storey Design Consultants
description: Our interior design philosophy is centred on creating spaces that balance functionality with comfort, beauty and individuality. Every project begins with a clear understanding of our clients’ requirements, alongside a careful assessment of the opportunities and constraints within the space. This considered approach enables us to deliver thoughtful, tailored interiors that are both practical and unique to each client. We offer a flexible and comprehensive range of design services, adapting to suit individual needs, styles and budgets. Our expertise includes spatial planning, optimising room layouts to achieve the best relationship between space and function, as well as lighting design, both of which form the foundation of successful interiors. Alongside these core principles, C+S provides interior design and sourcing, procurement, bespoke window treatments, soft furnishings, flooring and wall finishes. We also specialise in bespoke cabinetry and storage solutions, including the design of kitchens and bathrooms, as well as one off furniture pieces, artwork and custom finishes. In addition, we offer accomplished project management services, acting as our clients’ representative throughout the design and construction process. We work closely with contractors, suppliers and trades to coordinate every aspect of the project, helping to reduce stress and ensure a smooth, organised and enjoyable experience from concept through to completion.

name: Barclay Interiors
description: Headquartered in the UK, Barclay Interiors has been a leading name in interior design for 25 years, with a global portfolio of residential and commercial projects. Known for a timeless and individual approach, the practice emphasises uncompromising discretion and transparency. The skilled team avoids a prescriptive style, creating beautiful, tailored spaces through close collaboration with architects, artisans, and contractors. Their proactive and responsive nature has made them a trusted partner for homeowners, investors, luxury hospitality operators, HNWIs, and developers.

name: Sarah Chambers Interiors
description: Sarah Chambers has been working as an Interior Designer since 2000, running high end residential projects both in the UK and abroad. She enjoys working closely with her clients to translate their ideas into living spaces that are both stylish and practical. The practice offers the full range of architectural interior design skills needed for the complete refurbishment of a house including bathroom design and custom cabinetry where required. She will source from a wide range of suppliers and likes to mix vintage pieces with new purchases for a more sophisticated and eclectic look.

name: Fox Interior Design Ltd
description: Fox Interior Design is an established design studio that has a fantastic reputation for creating sophisticated interiors that elegantly combine a modern and classic scheme. Launched in 2000, Fox Interior Design's purpose is to guide a client through every stage of the design proecess from conception to specification and final installation. From the very beginning, Sarah has kept her studio focused on providing unwavering attention to each and every client and strives to make sure that every project undertaken is a very personal and highly enjoyable experience for all involved. Sarah has featured in Homes & Gardens, along with House & Garden magazine and is one of their recommended interior designers featured in The List directory. Our Interior Design Services: The service offered by Fox Interior Design is absolutely bespoke. Sarah oversees all projects and has a wonderful eye for design. She will manage the whole team through each stage of the proecess from initial ideas, specification to final build and completion. She is able to coordinate all aspects of the proejct workign closely with builders, archtects and specialist tradespeople. Sarah is an exceptional team leader and communicator. She is unflailingly personable, approachable and a reliable problem solver. name: Sarah Gordon Studio Limited
description: Sarah Gordon Studio is a Yorkshire-based interior design studio working with residential clients across the UK.

name: Deslyn Studio
description: Deslyn Studio was brought to life when, founder and creative director Sarah-Jane, combined her business acumen from a previous career in business development with her passion of interiors and art to create a boutique multidiscipline design studio. The Deslyn Studio ethos is to bring each project to life by injecting passion, working honestly, and using imagination to think outside the box; nurturing the client through their journey to help find their creative voice and bring emotion and experience to the forefront of the design solution, igniting the senses through colourful, tactile and layered designs. Each creative journey starts with a full circle exploration of all the unique characteristics and circumstances that have created the project. Whether it’s history, locale, geography, environment, lifestyle or personal passions – these elements inform the concept cues that each design element stems from. We deliver contemporary and timeless designs and experiences that work comfortably for all. Deslyn advocates the use of honest materials and therefore sources the best for quality, budget and timeless appeal, ensuring longevity for each project. Deslyn has forged lasting and honest relationships with architects, project managers, quantity surveyors, artists, artisans, craftsmen, furniture makers, joiners and contractors to ensure that a holistic programme can be delivered for all projects.

name: Studio Said
description: Studio Said is a residential & commercial interior design consultancy based in Yorkshire, working nationally. We are a small, approachable team and, alongside our skilled craftspeople, tradesmen, and trusted suppliers, we are committed to creating beautiful, timeless, and considered spaces that tell your story. Sarah Nicholson and her team offer a range of design services, from full renovations to hourly design consultations. Our goal is to design interiors that truly reflect the client and sympathetically consider the architecture of the property. We aspire to view every project as personal and unique, working closely alongside our clients from concept through to completion. Studio Said prides itself on a friendly, communicative approach, striving to make the design process as enjoyable and seamless as possible—exceeding clients’ expectations one project at a time.

name: Vanrenen Hanbury Ltd
description: Vanrenen Hanbury Ltd are known for their characterful and comfortable interiors that are layered with texture and colour. We use traditional methods and the best of British craftsmanship to create timeless rooms that work with both contemporary and traditional architecture.

name: Decibel Designs
description: Award winning interior designer, Sarah Wodehouse heads up Decibel Designs. The boutique practice is well versed in a variety of styles (the breadth of which we aim to show in the 'Projects' section below) and is able to accommodate projects both large and small with Sarah personally overseeing all aspects of the design process. She has 30 years of experience and during that time has developed close working relationships with architects, surveyors, project managers, lighting and audio visual consultants amongst others which enables her to form the teams required for larger commissions. Equally Sarah is happy to offer a single half day consultation to spark off inspiration and discuss practical ideas and possibilities, or a service in between the two. Sarah's work has taken her all over the UK and also to Europe and the USA. Clients have included many private individuals and presitigious organisations including All Souls College, Oxford, the American Ambassador to Denmark, and commercial outfits such as John Eskenazi (gallery), DA Consulting (offices), and Centre Parcs (event). With a degree in History of Art & Architecture, along with experience of working on both listed properties and new builds, Sarah is able to have an informed view on the spatial and structural possiblities of a building. name: FLOELLA Interiors
description: FLOELLA Interiors, a boutique interior design and soft furnishing studio, is run by interior designer Sarah Davies, who has brought a wealth of interior design experience to the Cotswold’s, following a career in London that spanned over twenty five years. Working in London & The Cotswolds on everything from, one room 'refreshes' to 'full interior design' services, FLOELLA Interiors is committed to offering clients the best service, advise and value for money. FLOELLA Interiors design Ethos is to design with the clients personality and lifestyle in mind to ensure that she creates a home that her clients will love and that will last the test of time. Classic sensibilitys marry with a love of pattern and colour to create Sarah's trademark design style. Sarah has a breadth of expertise that leaves her very much in demand far beyond the cotswolds where she runs FLOELLA Interiors loela is run by interior designer Sarah Davies, who has brought a wealth of Interior Design experience to the Cotswolds, following a career in London spanning twenty years. name: Sarah Brink Design
description: Sarah Brink Design is a bespoke interior design studio working across Central London, The Home Counties, and more recently Europe. Our studio prides itself on working closely with each Client to create stylish, elegant and functional interiors which reflect their individual needs and personality. Offering a complete range of services including interior architecture, design and decoration, our projects vary in size from full or part renovation projects, to producing sophisticated room schemes. With over 20 years interior deisgn experience, Sarah has built up a strong network of suppliers, craftspeople and consultants. This ensures that every project is meticulously planned; and a successful, cohesive scheme is delivered.

name: Kyson
description: Established in 2006, Kyson is an award-winning, architectural practice with a reputation for producing well-crafted, contextual and contemporary projects within the built environment. Studio Kyson’s schemes are a product of the relationship between programmatic requirements and the clear juxtaposition of place, space, light and materials. This approach, with an emphasis on the expression of architectural form and an underlying rationale derived from classic proportions, ensures that the aesthetic qualities of their architecture become integral to its functionality. The practice’s body of work is broad with commissions including private houses, interiors, hotels, restaurants and commercial space. Studio Kyson maintains a medium-sized, passionate design team that operates from its centrally located, creative studio in Shoreditch.

name: STUDIO by SE
description: STUDIO by SE Location: London, UK Specialisation: Boutique Residential & Commercial Interior Architecture and Design, Bespoke Furniture and Installations. STUDIO by SE is a distinguished London-based interior design studio founded in 2017, renowned for crafting timeless, elegant, and deeply personalised interiors. We specialise in boutique, high-end residential and commercial projects across the UK, offering a comprehensive, integrated approach. Our services encompass Interior Architecture, Interior and Furniture Design, Decoration, Styling, and Bespoke Installations. Each project is a testament to our commitment to refined craftsmanship, meticulous attention to detail, and a harmonious blend of classic tradition and contemporary innovation. Founder & Lead Designer: Stanislava (Slava) is the visionary founder of STUDIO by SE. Holding a Master of Science degree in Interior and Furniture Design, she brings over twenty-three years of extensive industry experience. Stanislava has a proven track record of transforming an exceptional range of spaces, from modern city apartments and period townhouses to Grade I listed buildings and grand country estates. Her diverse portfolio also includes sophisticated designs for aesthetic clinics, boutique hotels, beauty salons, and private members’ clubs, demonstrating her versatility and ability to create distinctive, enduring interiors. name: Shalini Misra Limited
description: Shalini Misra offers a wide spectrum of specialised and exclusive creative design concepts. Taking great pride in creating original work suitable to the needs and desires of the clients and has worked on projects in the UK, Germany, India and New York. Shalini Misra Ltd. are passionate about design and understand what makes a home exciting as well as comfortable to live in. Our design philosophy principles a people centred approach, a fusion of classical and contemporary design and the optimising of ecology and nature to create an ‘always lived there’ feeling. We have been transforming residential spaces for over a decade and take pride in creating original work suitable to the needs and desires of our clients. Our team have worked on projects in the UK and abroad ranging from new builds, structural alterations and complete restorations to decorating single rooms and sourcing all furnishings down to the last minute and well thought out detail. We offer a wide spectrum of specialised and exclusive creative design concepts to create the right ambience for our client’s homes. Our approach is exciting and innovative combining contemporary with period features of structure all the while considering the practical needs of a family home and creating a comfortable living space. We boast a fantastic team full of energy and enthusiasm for Interior and Architectural Designs and work collaboratively to provide the highest standard of service possible. name: Shalini Misra Limited
description: A qualified architect from the Delhi School of Architecture and Planning (SPA) in India, Shalini specialised in Urban Planning at the University of Columbia in New York before studying Virtual Reality in Architecture at the Bartlett School of Architecture, UCL, in London. One of House & Garden’s top 100 interior designers, Shalini is a British Institute of Interior Design (BIID) committee member, she is on the Advisory Board of KLC School of Design and on the Steering Committee of The Calico Club. She sits on the South Asian Acquisition Committee (SAAC) at Tate, and judges international design awards. Shalini is also a trustee and mentor of UK charity Vahani Scholarship Trust, a non-profit organisation that recognises the importance of opening doors for underprivileged children. Shalini also sits on the advisory board for Common Sense Media, a global charity dedicated to improving the well-being of children and families in the digital age. At Shalini Misra Ltd we create global multi award-winning interior design projects, specialising in luxury interiors for both residential and commercial developments. Founded in 1996 by visionary property developer and interior designer Shalini Misra, we have developed a diverse portfolio of exceptional projects from across the globe. Our ability to work closely with our clients, incorporating their needs while creating individual, functional, effective and timeless interiors, has fostered a discerning clientele.
