name: Gartner Lewin Ltd
description: Founded in 2010 Gartner Lewin is a London based luxury interior design practice specializing in Interior Architecture and design. They have built up a reputation of creating stunning, individual interiors and spaces for high end residential properties both in the UK & abroad. Spearheaded by Shelagh Gartner Lewinsohn, her knowledge and expertise has been gained through working in the luxury residential interior design sector internationally for over 20 years. Since completing her BA in Interior Architecture it is evident that her field is truly her passion. Shelagh has an appreciation for all eras and styles of design and an admiration for various cultural influences; allowing her to tap into different approaches for each of her clients. “My philosophy is to create timeless and elegant spaces that maximize the potential of a property, whilst being mindful and designing for 21st Century living. This ideology develops from deep understanding of my clients aspirations, a true appreciation for varying architectural and interior styles, along with in-depth understanding of the constraints of light, proportions, space, flow and environment. "My vision for each client is never the same as the last or the next, individuality within personal spaces is imperative for identity. The result is an interior that tells a story and most importantly reflects the client’s footprint in life… a successful interior should enhance not dictate the way you live.” Gartner Lewin has a excellent relation

name: Rees Architects
description: We are an award-winning studio creating bespoke renovations and interiors for London's heritage properties with personalised, elegant designs.

name: Shiran Sooriya-Arachchi
description: Shiran Sooriya-Arachchi (B.I.I.D) has 25+ years of building prestige retail, high-end residential, hospitality and educational interior design, architecture & branding identity work at international level. With 15 years specialising in store design for the Estée Lauder Group including Store Design Director for the Asia Pacific region, his work has been awarded and published. Building in emerging economies has become one of his specialties including built projects in Asia Pacific & the Middle East. He has led consultancy store design for Levi's, Levi's Girls, Clarins, Elizabeth Arden & Duty Free Shoppers (DFS). He designed the Art, Design & Media Library (ADM) at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore and the house for the Commander of Singapore Airforce, Singapore. His hospitality work has included concept development projects for the Oberoi Hotel Group, India, the Giorgio Armani Residences in Egypt and restaurant & bar designs for the owners of the Aman Resorts. He studied Interior Design at Kingston University, London where he was awarded a Commendation for Design. He later qualified in Architecture Year III to gain the Royal Institute of British Architects Part 1 exemption. He has also been awarded 1st place prize by the Singapore Institute of Architects in Open Competition. He is presently living & working in Singapore for the Architecture + Design firm Populous

name: Studio Sidika Limited
description: Creative Director & Founder Sidika Owen d’Hauteville set up Studio Sidika in 2015 after a decade long career in investment banking in the luxury goods sector. Studio Sidika has an in-house team of interior architects and designers to deliver a fully integrated design and project coordination service. We love working with clients who understand the value of owning a home that is design-led. Our work covers both residential and commercial projects in London. We speak English, French, Italian, German and Turkish.

name: Design ID
description: Services . Since our incorporation in 2005, our creative design studio has specialised in interior design, architectural refurbishment, and landscaping, delivering award-winning projects celebrated in industry publications. ​ With a diverse portfolio, we have transformed restaurants, cocktail bars, pubs, golf courses, and hospitality venues, as well as retail spaces and workspaces, into extraordinary environments that inspire and delight. ​ We believe every project begins with a story—a unique narrative tied to the site, its history, and the aspirations of our clients. Our role is to uncover this story and translate it into a design that feels authentic, purposeful, and timeless. Whether reimagining a single room or transforming an entire estate, our team takes a tailored approach, ensuring the result not only meets but exceeds expectations. ​ As a studio, we combine creativity with meticulous attention to detail. From selecting sustainable materials to designing bespoke furnishings, every decision is guided by our commitment to delivering designs that are both beautiful and functional. We are equally passionate about collaborating with a trusted network of partners, including architects, planners, and specialist contractors, to ensure seamless integration of all aspects of the project. Sustainability and wellness are at the heart of what we do. We strive to create spaces that connect people to their surroundings, inspire a sense of calm and joy, and minimise environmental im

name: Studio Ashby
description: Led by its Creative Director, Sophie Ashby, Studio Ashby creates spaces with a unique identity. Ashby’s aim is to bring authenticity to each project, not only in the selection of furniture, lighting and art but in its use of a natural palette of materials and textures. Unswayed by the passing dictates of fashion, Ashby draws on her love of antiques, colour, contemporary ‘world art’, modernist furniture, photography and her latest discoveries to deliver an eclectic richness to each interior. Studio Ashby’s relationships with artisans and craftsmen, extensive resources and continual foraging play an integral role in developing each project. Humour and a love of objects with an explicit narrative result in a carefully balanced body of work that create cohesive spaces with a sense of honesty. Sophie broadened her design vocabulary through a BA in History of Art (Hons) at Leeds University, going on to study Interior Design at Parsons, The New School in Manhattan, New York. Her strong architectural and design sensibility developed over the following years with sound. mentorship and a personal curiosity for “beautiful things”.

name: Alice Blue Interiors
description: Alice Blue Interiors specialises in sophisticated and luxurious interiors across the UK, based from our London studio. Our personable approach ensures every project is considered, beautifully realised and detailed to exacting standards. Individually tailored to our client's every need our ethos is driven to create elegant, comfortable and enduring interiors with practicality at its heart. Our studio is led by Sophie Fuller who has gained over 15 years of experience in luxury residential interior design. Her previous projects have encompassed everything from Grade I listed homes to new build properties and developments. Sophie has gained a wealth and breadth of project experience working for discerning clients from across the globe. Her personable approach is collaborative and tailors every client’s needs to suit their property, style and aspirations. Sophie’s passion is to create unique, intelligent and functional design solutions with personality and longevity at the forefront of her design aesthetic.

name: Studio Gorse
description: Sophie Chapman founded Studio Gorse in 2021, emerging in the wake of the pandemic. Founded by Sophie Chapman in 2021, Studio Gorse takes its name and inspiration from the Cornish coastline and flora—its rugged beauty and strong sense of place deeply influence the studio’s layered, nuanced interiors. With over a decade of industry experience in the South West and a First-Class BA (Hons) in Interior Design from Falmouth University, Sophie leads a dynamic studio focused on both residential and commercial projects. She has a particular affinity for Grade-listed and heritage buildings, approaching them with care, creativity and respect - blending historical character with a contemporary sensitivity. Studio Gorse is driven by authenticity, sustainability, and collaboration - drawing on a trusted network of local contractors, makers and artisans across the South West. Each project is approached with care, aiming to enhance everyday life and well-being through timeless, meaningful design. At the heart of Studio Gorse is a belief that well-designed spaces have the power to enhance everyday life and well-being. Sophie leads each project with a personal, hands-on approach—listening closely, collaborating openly, and building honest, enduring relationships with her clients and project partners. Every project is designed to stand the test of time—both in its beauty and in its integrity.

name: Just Sophie Interiors Ltd
description: I’m Sophie O’Sullivan, founder of Just Sophie Interiors, where I create thoughtful, concept-driven interiors shaped around how people truly live. Based in Oxfordshire and the Cotswolds, my work spans residential, commercial and boutique hospitality projects. My approach is grounded in both creativity and function, with a strong focus on flow, materiality and wellbeing. Having worked internationally, I bring a broad perspective to each project, but always keep the process personal, working closely with clients to design spaces that feel intuitive, timeless and uniquely theirs.

name: Tollgard Studio
description: Brought up in Stockholm, Staffan's personal style is born out of Asian and Scandinavian functionalism. He uses the Swedish expression of the 'red thread' to explain the design narrative that underpins every project. The thread is the guiding principle of creative endeavour, the core essence that he strives to find in each project. An architectural detail, a family heirloom, or a collection of art; each project has its own creative DNA that tells the client's story using the language of design. House and Garden's Leading 100 Designers says "Staffan' s flair for fusing modern furniture and art into chic, tailored interiors has made him a favourite with design-conscious families. Beautiful bespoke joinery is a given". Tollgard Studio offers an award-winning architectural interior design service for an international clientele. We work collaboratively and creatively to create bold, contemporary interiors that our clients can enjoy. Our design studio and showroom is located in Grosvenor Waterside, just by the Pimlico Road design area.

name: Sdias London
description: Sdias London is a team of experienced and talented designers with a wealth of complimentary industry networks. Our services include interior design, interior architecture, hospitality interior design, property development, home dressing/styling and FF&E packages. Our expertise and professional approach are tailored to each client to deliver high-quality services worldwide. Ensuring our projects are designed and managed from concept through to completion. Our projects extend from Europe to the USA, the Americas, Africa, and the Caribbean. We are based in Chelsea, London, UK and Montego Bay, Jamaica, West Indies.

name: atelier payne co. ltd
description: Winning his first job over 40 years ago with one of the world's leading hotel designers Frank Solano and then moving on to work with interior design giant John Stefanidis, Steven Payne has gone on to build his own thriving interior design practice. He has collaborated with Osborn Interiors in Oxfordshire, Rose Uniacke in London and Pascal Goujon in Nice. The best testimony is what others have to say , recently written about Payne and his staff in Spectacular Homes of London: 'designers like to work with their clients rather than or them, examining and discussing every facet of their lives until they can draw out their exact requirements. As a result no two projects look the same, but there is a confidence and sense of order that runs through all of the company' s work...' 'The practicality and level of comfort in his residential work have an echo in luxury hotels, combined with the truly bespoke personal detailing that is appropriate for a private home.' Above all, it is a personal endeavour for Payne; regardless of scope, brief, budget or location, each home, each project, each time he's given the opportunity to transform space. Steven specialises in: Residential interior architecture and design, decoration or simply; partial / full property design and redesign; Hotel, Bar and Restaurant interiors; Commercial Development concepts; Furniture Design and Feasibility Studies. Upon contact a complimentary appointment will be set up for you and Steven Payne to meet. Ideally, the m

name: Nashmita Rajiah Ltd
description: Nashmita Rajiah is a London-based interior architect and designer with over 20 years of experience, and the founder of her eponymous studio. Her work focuses on bespoke residential interiors, combining architectural clarity with a refined understanding of materiality, proportion, and how spaces are experienced in everyday life. Working internationally, she delivers projects ranging from private homes and penthouses to large-scale residences, each defined by a considered and cohesive approach. Nashmita began her career in London in 2006 at Candy & Candy, contributing to landmark ultra-prime developments including One Hyde Park, as well as private residences across London, Monaco, and Gibraltar. This early experience established a strong foundation in high-end residential design, with a particular emphasis on spatial hierarchy, craftsmanship, and precision. She later held senior roles within developer-led practices, including Head of Interior Architecture at Nstudio, part of Northacre PLC, where she led interior architecture across complex residential and mixed-use schemes. Before founding her studio in 2023, Nashmita worked independently with developers, architects, and private clients across the UK, Europe, and internationally. Her work today reflects this breadth of experience, underpinned by a disciplined and architectural approach to design.

name: Sue Dann Interiors
description: After obtaining a First Class Honours Degree in Fashion and Textiles Sue worked in the fashion industry for 20 years; in London, Paris and Italy as well as undertaking various projects in USA and the Far East. Sue' s passion for colour and texture, combined with her skills in spatial awareness and her love of architecture, were easily transported into the Interior Design Industry when she set up Sue Dann Interiors in 1998 after completing an Interior Design course at the KLC School of Interior Design in London. Originally established in South Bucks. Sue Dann Interiors has carried out a wealth of prestigious domestic renovation projects on period properties around Buckinghamshire, Berkshire, Surrey, Hampshire, London and the French Alps as well as many projects in Bath and Somerset. Sue has also carried out many Hotel and Restaurant projects around the country. After 3 years in Cornwall we have now relocated to South Somerset where we are in a much better location to better serve our clients in Surrey and Bath but can also still serve Cornwall, Devon and Dorset. We are now located in South Petherton , a beautiful Ham Stone Village in South Somerset. Contact email and mobile remain the same and we are happy to visit you and view your projects.

name: Fisher ID
description: My experience in interior design spans some thirty years, working mainly on residential projects in London and the Home Counties. Over the years, I have been involved in all aspects of design from architectural planning and detailing, through decoration and specialist finishes, and finally sourcing art and accessories to complete the project. In terms of style, I have implemented both traditional and modern design. My real strengths lie at the contemporary end of the spectrum although not the exclusion of all things traditional. I feel that the most successful projects are where the perfect balance between old and new has been achieved. Each new project affords opportunities to hone my skills in all aspects of design and I thrive on the challenges that my work provides. I spend a lot of time keeping abreast of technological advances in design as well as reading and attending exhibitions to keep up to date with the latest products available: all in order to provide my clients with the most current choices available. I have a passion for good design of all styles, and I truly believe that a well designed environment can improve the quality of life for those living and working within it. I consider it my duty as a designer to strive to provide the best possible solutions in terms of aesthetics, atmosphere and functionality within my client' s budget and time scale.

name: Sun Lee Jones
description: I am an ambitious senior designer with over 16 years experience of working on projects for top UK international retail brands and property development interiors in Weybridge Surrey. The last 8 years my work has involved bespoke luxury high end residential design development projects. Projects involve design and build to simple renovation work. I am capable of running projects from conception through to completion. My skills range from design presentation and project management, including supervision of contractors and budget control, to procurement. I am proficient in a variety of design programs, including Vectorworks. Educated to degree level with passes in 3-D Interior Design and Architecture. https://www.sunleejonesinteriors.com

name: Pfeiffer Design
description: Pfeiffer Design are a comprehensive interior architecture and design studio with a wealth of experience designing and bringing to fruition high-end bespoke homes. Within our team of 8 we specialise in every aspect of interior design, meaning we are confident we can design and implement your project, managing the process every step of the way. From technical drawings and selecting architectural finishes through to furniture specification and installation, we offer a one-stop-shop for all aspects of interior design. All our designs are unqiue to you, finding the balance between aesthetics, functionality and practicality with a holistic oversight. Our client-centred approach takes consideration for you, your lifestyle, family, pets and guests, meaning we really get to know who you are and how you want to live. In twenty years of trading we have developed a strong and reliable supply chain, employing the services of many unique, high-quality and trusted suppliers and tradespeople. We pride ourselves on our ability to really listen to our clients and this forms the basis of our design ethos. We do not impose design choices on our clients, and in our experience, this ensures we deliver exactly what our clients want at every turn. We select products based on their undeniable quality, sourced from a variety of suppliers, selected specifically with your project in mind. In short, Pfeiffer Design offer an unparalled design, specification and procurement service. Coupled with carefully-

name: Suzy Dallas Limited
description: BRINGING PRESTIGE INTERIORS TO LIFE WITH LIGHT Lighting transforms a space and can affect our mood and whole sense of well being. We are professional lighting designers and work with architects and developers, interior designers and private clients, to help them achieve the wow factor and maximise the value of their investment. And for the projects for which a lighting designer has not been hired.... we have also developed a series of lighting tutorials which can be accessed here LINK

name: SLJ Interiors
description: With over 30 years’ experience in the industry, Sylvia Lawson Johnston’s fabulous projects have led her to be included in House and Garden’s Top 100 Interior Designers for many years. What makes Sylvia stand out is her natural ability to create completely bespoke environments combining a mixture of antique, vintage and modern pieces with colour, pattern and texture. Sylvia enjoys creating houses that stand the test of time and reflect the character of their owners. She creates a timeless sense of elegance rather than being led by passing fashions. Sylvia builds relationships with her clients who frequently come back to her when they move house, which is the best vote of confidence. Email Sylvia@sljinteriors.co.uk to discuss any projects and to make an appointment.

name: Symbiotic Living
description: Drawing strength from her own personal journey of loss, award-winning interior designer Sharlene Young has a deep understanding of the profound effect that a person’s built environment can have on their health and well-being. Harnessing her passion for human-centered design, Sharlene launched Symbiotic Living in Chicago in 2016 with a mission to elevate homes beyond mere living spaces, creating environments where individuals can truly thrive. Now, with a global perspective honed from Sharlene’s life in Chicago and London and a personal pull toward Rome, Symbiotic Living continues to craft sustainable, life-enhancing spaces for clients in the U.K. and U.S.

name: Tabitha Isobel
description: Tabitha Isobel was founded in early 2023 by Tabitha Organ. The studio is based in London and has projects across the UK. Tabitha has a decade of experience in the industry. She achieved a Bachelor Honours Degree in Interior Design from Falmouth University. Prior to founding Tabitha Isobel she has worked for the prestigious, Conran + Partners and the innovative, Sella Concept. Tabitha Isobel is a dynamic interior design studio dedicated to creating captivating environments that seamlessly blend history with contemporary flair, delivering distinctive and timeless design experiences. We listen, we have integrity and we are honest. We are not driven by trends, but by authenticity. We love what is old and we thoughtfully introduce what is new. We aim to inspire clients, bring their vision to life and exceed expectations. At the core of the studio ethos is the knowledge that a well designed space always has a positive impact on life and well-being. With sustainability at the forefront of our minds, we are creative in how we reuse, recycle and re-purpose elements within Interior Design and are considered in our material and furniture choices. We are passionate about designing spaces that will stand the test of time in their durability and their aesthetic. Ultimately, we love what we do!

name: Taida Salaber Interiors Ltd
description: Taida Salaber is an interior designer with 20 years of professional experience, working in the industry since 2006. A graduate of the Academy of Fine Arts in Gdańsk, where she studied Interior Architecture, Taida has built her career in Scotland, including working within award-winning showrooms before establishing her independent design practice. Her experience spans residential interiors, period properties, renovations and bespoke high-end projects. Having worked in Scotland for many years, Taida has developed extensive knowledge of the local interiors industry and established relationships with suppliers, manufacturers and specialist trades. Taida approaches each project individually, with no prescribed house style. Her work is guided by the architecture and character of the property, alongside the lifestyle, needs and personality of her clients. Combining creativity with a strong understanding of functionality and technical detail, she creates considered, distinctive interiors designed to feel personal and to stand the test of time.

name: Tanya Bentley Ltd
description: Tanya Bentley is an Interior Architecture studio specialising in major residential refurbishments. Ours is a hard-to-come-by, top-to-bottom, end-to-end service. A considered approach that reveals your property’s full potential and brings joy to your home. From bold moves that unlock hidden light and space; to innovative structural remodelling that becomes the key to a seamless flow; and beautiful sight-lines that spark everyday moments of delight. From joyful colour and texture, through to the subtle thoughtful details that make all the difference, we create elegant spaces that combine form and function for delightful modern living. http://tanyabentley.co.uk/

name: Seven & Co
description: Behind every extraordinary space is a designer who understands that luxury isn't just about expensive materials - it's about creating environments that tell your story and enhance your life. M y journey from award-winning studios to creating bespoke interiors across the UK and worldwide has taught me that the most beautiful spaces are born from genuine collaboration and meticulous attention to detail. ​ My multicultural background brings a unique perspective to every project. Whether I'm restoring a heritage property with sympathetic reverence for its history, designing a contemporary family home that balances luxury with liveability, or creating commercial spaces that captivate clients, I draw inspiration from diverse cultural influences to create designs that are both timeless and distinctly personal.

name: TK Projects Ltd
description: Tia Kirwan is offering more than a decade of experience in building and refurbishing residential properties in the U.K. and USA. Throughout her career, she has been focusing on elevating and bettering her clients’ surroundings, life style and well-being.

name: Gosling Ltd
description: Tim Gosling established Gosling, following an accomplished 18-year tenure as a Director at Linley. Tim, driven by a passion for design encompassing architecture, interiors, furniture and the arts, possesses a unique talent for seamlessly blending these disciplines. Originating his career in theatre design, Tim infuses a dash of drama into his creations, complemented by meticulous attention to detail, resulting in perfect performances. Assembling a team carefully chosen to not only mirror his style, but also express their distinct and original design expertise, Tim has curated a portfolio featuring private and commercial commissions, such as the Goring Hotel and BP Headquarters. The Gosling team’s collaboration with global interior designers, yacht designers and architects contirubte to a diverse portfolio of international projects. Gosling's bespoke interior and furniture design services have earned an international reputation for excellence. Drawing inspiration from classical architecture with a contemporary twist, the design process begins closely with clients to ensure their needs and preferences are reflected in each meticulously crafted interior. Every furniture item and element of an interior adheres to rigorous standards, employing the finest materials and traditional cabinet-making techniques.

name: Timothy A Ryan Associates
description: Founded in 1986 and based In Brecon, South Wales, and London we believe exceptional design is about balancing creativity, quality, and practicality. Our approach combines ingenuity with a clear understanding of budget, craftsmanship, and the realities of delivering successful projects. With years of experience in luxury residential design, we create thoughtful and beautifully considered spaces that reflect the individuality of each client. From initial concepts through to completion, every detail is approached with care, ensuring the highest standards of quality while remaining conscious of costs and value. We understand that great design should not only inspire but perform practically and financially. That is why we focus on delivering creative, achievable solutions tailored to each project — combining traditional craftsmanship, professional expertise, and clear project guidance throughout the process. At Timothy A Ryan Associates, our goal is simple: to transform ideas into refined, well-crafted spaces that are both distinctive and deliverable.

name: DECOR TOKYO Co., Ltd
description: Decor Tokyo is an interior design office that performs renovation, renovation, interior coordination, etc. The concept of beautiful space is the result of being functional which is our focus when renovating. We will take care of the sound, light and thermal environment, not to mention the housework line, the ease of life, the storage plan. We also accept small renovations and requests for interior coordination that are not accompanied by construction work.

name: Westcot House
description: Tor Dighero, owner and founder of Westcot House, has always worked closely with a team of very experienced and talented makers and it’s these relationships that are key to producing excellent work time and again. Working for many years in publishing as a magazine editor, Tor loves the teamwork that goes into creating something beautiful, unique and worthwhile. At Westcot House the ethos is very personal. Tor and the team get to know you, the client, and work within the style of the home and your own personal take on interiors. We are used to working in period properties where there are sometimes challenges but where we will always be sympathetic to the architecture and history of the house. Projects have been completed in London, the home counties and abroad. Tor and the team love talking to clients about their projects and are happy to discuss anything from a whole house to a single room, or even just a headboard or cushion. We work with commitment and dedication. We are also delighted to be introducing our very own online store. Here we have curated a mix of cushions, furniture, home fragrances and accessories which you can buy directly from us by heading to our shop. Based in the old town of Beaconsfield, we have a showroom with an extensive fabric library open to clients by appointment.

name: Txengo Studio
description: We are a dynamic, multi-disciplinary design studio based in London, specializing in creating stunning, contemporary interiors for the Hospitality, Residential, and Luxury Travel sectors. Our mission is to capture the essence of our clients' brand identity and lifestyle, ensuring every space is a true reflection of their unique vision and individuality. With a global perspective and an international clientele, we draw inspiration from diverse cultural influences to bring creativity and vibrancy to every project. Our extensive experience across a wide range of business challenges allows us to seamlessly blend functionality with luxury, transforming spaces where people live, work, and thrive. We are designers, visionaries, listeners, makers, and doers. We bring your dreams to life.

name: Vanessa Buirski Interiors
description: Vanessa Buirski lives in London and started her Interior Design Practice in 2002. Since then she has been working with residential clients based in London, the Home Counties and Europe providing both a comprehensive Interior Design service as well as hourly consultation if required. From period restorations to contemporary projects, realising the potential and character of very diverse homes and client wishes. Vanessa's reputation has been built on her personal and collaborative approach, her talent for colour, lighting expertise and space planning. A more extensive portfolio of her work can also be seen on Houzz https://www.houzz.co.uk

name: Katherine Varnava Interiors
description: Katherine Varnava is the Founder and Creative Director of Katherine Varnava Interiors , a London-based luxury interior design studio specialising in elegant, bespoke residences across prime addresses including Hampstead, Mayfair, Chelsea, and Central London. With a portfolio spanning distinguished private homes and landmark refurbishments, Katherine is recognised for delivering timeless interiors that combine architectural depth with understated sophistication. With over a decade of experience in the high-end interiors sector, Katherine leads every project with creative integrity and a meticulous eye for detail. Her practice offers a fully comprehensive interior architecture and FF&E service. From spatial planning, lighting design and bespoke joinery, through to curated finishes, soft furnishings and on-site styling. Each project is carefully tailored to reflect the client’s lifestyle, aspirations, and the unique character of the property. Katherine is particularly known for her ability to transform complex residential projects into seamless design journeys, often acting as Lead Designer across all RIBA stages. Working alongside some of London’s leading contractors, architects and artisans, she ensures every element is executed to the highest level. The studio offers in-house joinery design and bespoke furniture production, ensuring total control over quality, detailing and finish. For international clients and private homeowners alike, Katherine Varnava Interiors delivers a

name: The Vawdrey House Ltd
description: The Vawdrey House is a multi-award winning interior design and architecture studio which offers a dynamic combination of soulful design, strategic thinking and creative flair. Working across high-end commercial and residential projects, we specialise in bringing both architecture and interior design together to create beautiful spaces, unique to the individual families and organisations that use them. With our select team of creative experts, our interwoven approach seamlessly blends interior design, architecture and the landscape. This enables us to envision how spaces will be used and how they will look and feel both inside and out. We consider all aspects of the project from the outset, developing them on with ruthless attention to detail and professional project management to deliver well thought out, cohesive projects that defy mainstream solutions and exceed expectations.

name: Victor Gradinaru Interiors
description: Victor Gradinaru Interiors, is a London-based boutique interior design studio with projects across the UK and abroad. Founded to provide class-leading designs, we believe every space should tell a story—yours! That’s why our designs focus on timeless elegance and sustainable, bespoke creations that reflect each client’s unique vision. Led by Founder and Creative Director Victor Gradinaru, we push the boundaries of creativity and redefine the art of living. Every project undertaken by the VG Interiors is personal, blending functionality with beauty. We listen closely to our clients, translating their needs and aspirations into thoughtful design concepts that elevate everyday living. Our work spans the globe, from the modern skylines of Singapore and San Francisco to the timeless charm of London and Sydney. Recent projects include two developments in South Kensington and private residences in London, the Cotswolds, and beyond. Current commissions include a family home and a harbourfront residence in Sydney. Whether you’re looking to refresh a single room or transform your entire home, we’re here to bring your vision to life. Explore more of what we do at www.victorgradinaru.com or reach out directly, we’d love to hear from you!

name: Victoria Caldwell Design
description: Victoria Caldwell Design manages residential projects with private individuals, architects and developers. We work along side our clients, advising but not forcing a particular style. We approach the design process as a collaboration of ideas, styling and designing spaces for the way families or individuals want to live. The studio works closely with clients to create unique interiors that reflect their vision. We form the initial Design concept of the project, mood and fabric boards, to compiling and issuing technical drawing packages. We oversee the design throughout the build and final installation to ensure a successful outcome. We hand source finishes, fabrics, furniture and lighting for our clients, producing beautiful Interior Design schemes that encompass their world.

name: McGuinness Architects
description: With a personal focus on bespoke and the emotive quality of materials, Victoria works closely with clients to define a functional and aesthetic brief that is answered with sensitive, considered design specific to the client and their unique story. As principal interior designer for McGuinness Architects she works both independently and alongside the architectural team on residential and select commercial projects for the studio. With a degree in Interior Design from Parsons, The New School for Design in New York, Victoria was awarded the graduating prize in Design Excellence. She credits her training there for her rigorous approach to space-planning (she was taught by architects) and her commitment to drawing as an essential part of the design process, revealing both opportunity and potential pitfall. Her first degree in Fashion Communication at Central St Martin’s (and subsequent career as a fashion writer) has helped shape a creative thinking process and the ability to read and interpret mood. Returning to London in 2017, Victoria has worked for a number of eminent London design studios (HBA, Hubert Zandberg, Peter Mikic, Hazel Collins) with projects for private clients in London, New York, Miami and Colorado.

name: Violet And George
description: Violet & George was founded in 2009 by Nicky Mudie, following a decade of experience in the interior design industry and a lifelong passion for textiles, craftsmanship, and considered, luxury design. With a deep-rooted understanding of soft furnishings and decorative arts, Nicky established the studio to offer beautifully tailored interiors with soul and personality. Nicky studied Textile Design at art college before completing a degree in the History of Art & Design at Leeds University. She apprenticed under Daniel Hopwood at his West London studio, then spent seven years as Head Designer at Godrich Interiors, where she played a key role in building and shaping the studio. What sets Violet & George apart is the attention we pay to what truly matters to our clients. We offer a flexible interior design and decoration service that adapts to individual needs — from full interior schemes to made-to-measure curtains and upholstery, paint and fabric consultations, intelligent solutions, and signature decorative details. Working from our West London studio and soft furnishings workshop in Hampshire, our designers and skilled craftsmen collaborate with a trusted network of specialists to deliver exceptional quality and a highly personalised, joyful client experience.

name: WaMa Designs
description: WaMa Designs was established in May 2009 and is headed by Design Director Wan Zainal Abidin - whose previous experience includes running two companies under his capacity as the creative head. He has 20 over years of experience in the design field and has been the main design consultant for major corporate clients in Brunei, including DST Communications, TelBru, Bank Islam Brunei Darussalam (BIBD), Insurans Islam TAIB, MAERSK, Jerudong Park Medical Centre (JPMC) and Pantai Jerudong Specialist Centre. WaMa Designs is known to be the only design company specializing in Commerical Interiors and Branding in Brunei Darussalam. With professionally qualified key personnel in related fields, we have a strong and practical approach to improving and creating Corporate Identity and developing New Branded Environments.

name: White by Mehar
description: Welcome to Your Home of Luxury Design At our studio, we believe that true luxury is personal. Based in the UK and operating globally, we specialize in creating interiors that are not just beautiful but are a reflection of your unique style and way of life. Whether you're looking for interior design, home styling, bespoke furniture, turnkey project management, or complete FF&E solutions, we're your one-stop solution. Our approach to design is all about understated elegance—spaces that feel luxurious yet welcoming, sophisticated yet comfortable. We take the time to understand your aesthetics and lifestyle, ensuring every detail of your project is tailored to you. We also offer exclusive design packages, with special discounts available for BIID fellow members. Let’s create something extraordinary together! you can find us on the following https://whitebymehar.co.uk/ https://www.instagram.com/wbm_uk/

name: Drumkilbo Designs
description: I started decorating over 24 years ago, during which time my style has evolved with the times. Living mostly in Scotland. I have decorated castles, country houses and shooting lodges ; often in the very far north of Scotland. I specialise mostly in traditional country house style with often an unexpected modern twist. I try to use wonderful textured and ageless fabrics, which help to lose the 'newly decorated' feel. I often use wonderful silks for curtains with unusual trimmings and fringes so they look as if they have hung there for generations. I prefer to work with my clients to achieve a home which suits them. I believe in getting to know my client, so together we can achieve a home which they will enjoy living in and which suits their family' s needs and their lifestyle. Although I mostly work in Scotland, I work also in England, Wales and abroad, where I greatly enjoy the different challenges of finding the right craftsmen in the right place at the right cost. I find that even after decorating for a number of years, I am still learning the whole time, which I feel keeps my style and mind open to all sorts of new ideas which can be combined to their best advantage.

name: William Deakins Architects
description: William Deakins Architect is a design-led architectural design consultancy based in London with a portfolio of private residential, commercial and conservation projects, delivering unique, finely crafted architectural, interiors and landscape projects. We approach each project with a genuine passion for high quality design and detail. We develop practical buildable solutions, pursuing a timeless modern aesthetic, respectful of context. Collaboration is at the heart of our approach. We work closely with our clients to conceive refined design solutions, tailored to our clients’ needs, delivered in a practical hands-on way. We have extensive experience and a proven track record, with our diverse catalogue of completed projects speaking for itself. William Deakins is a registered member of the RIBA with 25 years of professional experience, having studied and qualified at the Royal College of Art and University of Westminster.

name: William Woods Interior Design
description: Sarah Woods offers a friendly, comprehensive interior design service specialising in the design and decoration of country homes throughout the UK. The design team present schemes from the simple to the sophisticated, subtle and understated, reflecting character without imposing on the surroundings. The aim is always to create an individual, stylish, comfortable home which compliments both the property and its owners. Respected for quality and attention to detail, William Woods Interior Design operate their own workshops, with a team of highly skilled craftspeople making curtains and furnishings to an exceptionally high standard. For further information please telephone for an informal chat on +44(0)1423 530111 or email

name: Be-kin
description: Be-Kin is an interior design studio known for its holistic approach to design. We provide a full interior design service, tailored to each project. It draws inspiration from my passion for art, creative expression and interest in spiritual healing. I believe that the spaces we occupy have a profound impact on how we feel, and I love creating environments that bring our clients joy, comfort and inspiration. The talented Be-Kin team have a wealth of knowledge, experience and creative skills. We enjoy working together to create beautiful spaces for our clients. The studio is based in Primrose Hill, London UK. We work all over the world - Be Local. Be Global. Be-Kin. For more information or to book in a complimentary consultation please contact us on , or call the studio on 0203 435 9322. About Wren Loucks Wren is the Founder & Creative Director of Be-Kin. She is an award-winning designer, who has spent her life exploring how the spaces we occupy play a role in our physical, emotional and spiritual health. Wren is a fully registered member of the British Institute of Interior Design and the Society of British and International Designers. Her professional qualifications include a Bachelor of Fine Arts Honors Degree from Queen’s University, Canada, a Post-Graduate Diploma in Architectural Interior Design from the Inchbald School of Design and a Masters in Business Administration (MBA) from University College London. Alongside overseeing the studio, Wren guest lectures about design

name: PhD inc.
description: PhD inc. は、日本(2024年設立)に拠点を置くプロのデザイン事務所で、包括的なインテリアデザインを提供し、商業、住宅、家具のデザインを世界規模でコンサルティングしています。弥生のキャリアは、1992年に日本のクリスチャンフィッシュバッハーで始まりました。彼女はスタイリッシュなショールームの営業スタッフの一人であり、ヨーロッパの生地について有意義な知識を築き、専門家や一般の顧客に良いサービスを提供しています。いくつかの会社でインテリアデザインとして働いた後、住宅とキッチンのデザインが彼女の専門になりました。彼女はインテリア建築であり、絶妙な輸入素材への関心と地元の伝統的な職人技を組み合わせています。ディテール、品質、エレガンス彼女のトレードマーク。そのため、彼女のデザインは洗練されていて洗練されていますが、深く快適で、壮大なリラクゼーションの雰囲気を与えていると感じるでしょう。彼女のデザインは、しばしば現代の日本の高品質のスタイルと表現されています。

name: Yoko Kloeden Design
description: Yoko Kloeden Design is a London-based architecture and interior design studio, founded by Yoko Kloeden in 2016. Located in West London, the studio specialises in crafting mood-enhancing sanctuaries, seamlessly blending Japanese aesthetics with natural, serene elements. Each project aims to create spaces that feel both harmonious and deeply restorative, reflecting Yoko’s commitment to calm, balanced interiors. With an early career in business and finance, Yoko Kloeden travelled extensively throughout Asia, North America, and Europe. Her journey exposed her to many contrasting environments, from impersonal airport lounges to uninspired hotel rooms, inspiring her to create interiors rooted in peace and purpose. Having grown up in Kyoto, Japan, Yoko has long appreciated the quiet power of nature, frequently finding solace in temple gardens and embracing the tranquillity they provide. Central to Yoko Kloeden Design’s philosophy is the Japanese principle of Yugen — a deep sense of presence and peace found in the subtle beauty of life. Drawing from this philosophy, the studio has distilled five guiding principles to foster balanced, calm environments. These principles are Hikari (Light), Nagame (View), Ma (Space), Shizen (Nature), and Taru o Shiru (Less is More), each one focused on cultivating harmony and simplicity. Today, Yoko Kloeden Design provides a full range of architecture and interior design services for private and commercial clients, carefully crafting every space to bri

name: acanthus
description: Acanthus is a Tokyo-based interior design office where Yukiko Sato provides planning and designing for residential, show flat, and shop interior design and renovation. Yukiko's career started as a colour analyst at OZ Colour Studio, where she provided clients with colour consultation services. She then worked on many interior design projects at a lighting company, Yamagiwa Corp., and additionally at a renovation company. Along with her interior designing, she provided decorative flower arrangements for Yamagiwa's showroom displays. She then established her own company. Yukiko excels at sophisticated and contemporary Zen Style designs. She offers interior designs with a natural appeal that represents iyashi, a sense of comfort, which has been traditionally valued in Japan. The finishing touches she provides come from her specialized knowledge of Imari porcelain and other antiques, and also from her flower arrangement techniques.

name: Zaniz Studio
description: ZANIZ Studio is an established design practice founded in New York City, recognised internationally for its innovative and considered approach to interior design. The studio brings over 30 years of experience across high-end residential and commercial projects worldwide. The practice is known for a rigorous approach to design, craftsmanship, and detailing, with a portfolio spanning private residences, commercial spaces, bespoke yachts, resorts, and furniture design. Each project reflects a commitment to originality of thought and a refined understanding of how design shapes human experience. ZANIZ Studio blends beauty, technology, and craftsmanship to create environments that are emotionally engaging, enduring, and responsive to their context. The studio’s work consistently pushes the boundaries of contemporary design while remaining grounded in quality and purpose. Alongside the studio’s client work, Zaniz is engaged in ongoing research into how interiors and the built environment can support long-term human wellbeing. This includes the development of Longevity House™ , a long-term design research project exploring the relationship between space, technology, and quality of life. The studio remains committed to creating meaningful environments that respond to contemporary challenges and contribute positively to society. For enquiries, please contact Contact@zaniz.com .

name: Zara Christie Limited
description: Often refered to as the "Translator" on projects, Zara Christie has been restoring and refurbishing properties since 1990. Zara and her team work with clients from the initial concept through to a turn-key solution. Zara's small practice based in Farnham Surrey also have studios in Hampshire and London. Zara believes homes are a reflection of the clients personality and lifestyle, not just a canvas for the latest trends or fashions. Zara and her team pride themselves on attention to detail in creating functional, elegant and stylishly comfortable homes, and the full-service interior design agency can provide clients with interior and outdoor living design solutions.

name: Huxley Home Design Group
description: Zara has over a decade of experience as an Interior designer, working on a diverse range of residential and commercial projects in the UK and overseas. She founded her own practice Huxley Home in 2015 following training at London's Inchbald School of Design and six years in house at the renowned Staffan Tollgard Design Group. Zara's signature style channels the relaxed, eclectic charm of English Interior design, updated for 21st century living.

name: Ohra Studio by Desirum Ltd
description: Boasting over a decade of dedicated experience as an interior designer, Zlata has carved a prominent niche within the architectural and design realm. Commencing her journey in 2014, she established her first architectural agency in Brussels, setting the stage for her illustrious career. In 2020, Zlata strategically relocated her interior design studio to London, a city synonymous with creativity and innovation. This move positioned her at the forefront of interior design, enabling her to seamlessly orchestrate captivating spaces in the heart of London. Today, based in London, Zlata's expertise spans across diverse domains, encompassing everything from home and hotel design to office and hospitality interior design. Her meticulous eye for detail, combined with an innate ability to create bespoke solutions, forms the foundation of her practice. With a distinguished presence in the realm of interior decoration, Zlata is renowned for crafting timeless residential havens and luxurious hotel spaces that exude charm. Her commercial acumen and creative finesse intertwine seamlessly, resulting in office and hospitality designs that seamlessly blend functionality and aesthetics. Zlata's affiliation as an honoured member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID) and the Society of British and International Design (SBID) underscores her unwavering commitment to excellence. Her journey as an architect, entrepreneur, and interior design virtuoso reflects a profound belief in the p

name: A2Dominion Rental Only
description: A2Dominion Rental Only is an award-winning landlord that has been renting and managing homes for over 40 years. They offer a wide range of properties to meet customers' needs and budget. Design, with a focus on quality, is at the heart of all their developments. By building in the right locations they aim to create a sense of place that improves people’s lives. Each development is professionally let and managed. ‘Good, Honest, Renting’ is their goal, and all profits are reinvested to support A2Dominion’s social purpose. The A2Dominion Rental Only portfolio ranges from studio apartments to three-bedroom penthouses across London, Bristol and southern England, in urban and suburban locations. In addition, many residents have access to a range of facilities on site. These may include a gym, a concierge service and a roof terrace. A2Dominion Rental Only developments on HomeViews include Redcliff Quarter, Invicta, Exchange Gardens and Fellows Square. Some reviewers were offered an incentive for an honest review, regardless of rating

name: A2Dominion
description: A2Dominion is a residential property group based in the UK, who own and manage over 32,000 homes across London and Southern England. Its property portfolio is diverse with a range of affordable, private and social rented homes, housing for older people alongside student, NHS and temporary accommodation. Deepak House, West Plaza, Keybridge House - Exchange Gardens, Green Man Lane Estate and Carlton House are all A2Dominion developments listed on HomeViews. These are mainly situated in Central and West London. One prominent development is West Plaza located next to the Staines Reservoirs on Town Lane in Ashford. Ashford station is the nearest Rail station being only a twelve-minute walk away. Some reviewers were offered an incentive for an honest review, regardless of rating

name: AA Homes & Housing
description: AA Homes & Housing is a UK developer based in Croydon, with vast experience in property, operating across three business sectors. The company has a ‘successful history of linking property solutions to a large property portfolio.’ AA Homes & Housing currently manages over 640 units and 186 land sites across England and Wales. HomeViews lists a number of AA Homes & Housing developments, mainly in Croydon, which is just nine miles south of Central London. Cygnet House offers luxury apartments in a central location, right by East Croydon station — only a 15-minute journey from Victoria and London Bridge stations. 5 Sydenham Road is another AA Homes & Housing development, which was designed by the architect Carter Jonas. Some reviewers were offered an incentive for an honest review, regardless of rating

name: abrdn
description: Reviews marked with a green tick show tenants whose residency we have been able to verify. Those that could not be verified are marked 'unverified'. We believe the best information about a residential development comes from the people living there. Owners and tenants have a lot of useful information to share with their prospective neighbours, not just on the property itself and its locality, but also on the developer and the building's management.

name: Abri Homes
description: Abri Homes was formed out of the merging of Radian Homes and Yarlington Homes. Based in the south of England, the company is one of the largest housing associations with over 5,000 homes and 80,000 residents. description: Weston Homes was formed in 1987 by Bob Weston and is now one of the major property developers in the South East of England. Weston Homes has established a reputation for high quality design and build standards, delivered with a desire to make a genuine difference to the lives of our customers and to leave a legacy of which we are justly proud. Weston Homes combines the traditional skills of house-building with the ever-expanding opportunities created by new technology. British Offsite, one of Weston Group's subsidiary companies, has taken a revolutionary approach to property development. From the buildings’ structural and internal walls through to bathroom fittings, wardrobes and kitchen fittings, as much as possible is now pre-manufactured and tested in their own carefully controlled British Offsite factories, rather than on site. This drives up the environmental performance of the homes through reduced energy usage and wastage of materials during construction to greater energy efficiency for the homeowner, whilst maximising the quality of the finished properties. Weston Homes’ developments are hugely varied, ranging from select housing developments to large-scale city apartment complexes of many hundreds of homes. As well as new-build, the company has extensive experience of refurbishment and restoration work, breathing new life into historic and Listed buildings to give new purpose to Britain’s architectural heritage. description: Wildheart Residential was born out of City Lofts Group, who went into administration in 2008, the company was set up as a "vehicle to allow for the ongoing management of a portfolio of about £40 million new built residential developments". This management company now manages around 3,000 residential units and are based in Epsom, Surrey, however they manage buildings across the whole of the UK. Quayside Lofts is a residential development listed on HomeViews managed by Wildheart Residential. It is located on the north bank of the River Tyne in Newcastle and only a few minutes walk away from the City Centre and less than 500m from Newcastle Central Station, which has access to a wide range of rail services. The development is comprised of 2-bedroom apartments with a "stylish, cosy décor", majority of apartments are fitted with balconies and parking permits are available for those who wish to purchase them. Residents praise Quayside Lofts on HomeViews for being spacious and modern with helpful staff and also, for having great transport links to the centre of Newcastle. “The design a very nice, with a spacious living room. The building is also very well maintained, with nice interiors. There is not much sense of a community in the development, though everyone is pleasant enough, but everything is very close and you can make great friends around. The parking is great with the underground parking facilities. Supermarkets and the train station are really close by too.” - Chris F, Ver
